contentMarkdown: 设 $ z=\frac{1}{x}f(xy)+y\varphi(x+y) $， $ f,\varphi $ 具有二阶连续导数，则 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}= $ ___
explanationMarkdown:
第一步：求 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} $。
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{1}{x^{2}}f(xy)+\frac{1}{x}\cdot yf^{\prime}(xy)+y\varphi^{\prime}(x+y). 
$$
第二步：求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} $。
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=yf^{\prime\prime}(xy)+\varphi^{\prime}(x+y)+y\varphi^{\prime\prime}(x+y). 
$$

contentMarkdown:
设 $ z = xf(x - y) + yg(x + y) $，其中 f 与 g 有二阶连续导数，则 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}} - \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}} $ 等于

A. $ 2(f'-g') $
B. $ f'-g' $
C. $ f'+g' $
D. $ xf''+yg'' $
explanationMarkdown: 由 $ z = xf(x - y) + yg(x + y) $ 得 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=f+x f^{\prime}+y g^{\prime},\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-x f^{\prime}+g+y g^{\prime} $，所以 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}=f^{\prime}+f^{\prime}+x f^{\prime \prime}+y g^{\prime \prime}=2f^{\prime}+x f^{\prime \prime}+y g^{\prime \prime} $， $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=x f^{\prime \prime}+g^{\prime}+g^{\prime}+y g^{\prime \prime}=x f^{\prime \prime}+2g^{\prime}+y g^{\prime \prime} $，故 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}-\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=2f^{\prime}-2g^{\prime}=2(f^{\prime}-g^{\prime}) $，应选(A)。

contentMarkdown: 设  $ u = yf\left(\frac{x}{y}\right) + xg\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) $，其中 f, g 具有二阶连续导数，求  $ x\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}} + y\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y} $.
explanationMarkdown:
函数
$$u=yf\left(\frac{x}{y}\right)+xg\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)$$是关于 $x,y$ 的一阶齐次函数。由欧拉公式
$$xu_x+yu_y=u.$$两边对 $x$ 求偏导，得到
$$u_x+xu_{xx}+yu_{xy}=u_x,$$因此
$$xu_{xx}+yu_{xy}=0.$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ f, g $ 为连续可微函数， $ u = f(x, xy) $， $ v = g(x + xy) $，求 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} \cdot \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} $。
explanationMarkdown:
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial f(x, xy)}{\partial x} = f_{1}^{\prime} \cdot \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}x} + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot \frac{\partial(xy)}{\partial x} = f_{1}^{\prime} + y f_{2}^{\prime}. 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial g(x+xy)}{\partial x} = g^{\prime}(x+xy) \cdot \frac{\partial(x+xy)}{\partial x} = (1+y)g^{\prime}(x+xy). 
$$
 故 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} \cdot \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} = g^{\prime}(x+xy)(1 + y)(f_{1}^{\prime} + yf_{2}^{\prime}) $。

contentMarkdown: 设 $ z = f\left(xy, \frac{x}{y}\right) + g\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) $，其中 $ f, g $ 均可微，则 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = $ ___。
explanationMarkdown:
本题考查抽象复合函数求偏导，使用链式法则。将 $ y $ 视为常数，对 $ x $ 求偏导： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = y f_{1}^{\prime} + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot \frac{1}{y} + g^{\prime} \cdot \left(-\frac{y}{x^{2}}\right) = y f_{1}^{\prime} + \frac{f_{2}^{\prime}}{y} - \frac{y}{x^{2}} g^{\prime}. 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ f(u,v) $ 为二元可微函数， $ z = f(x^{y}, y^{x}) $，则 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = $ ___。
explanationMarkdown:
根据链式法则，对 $ x $ 求偏导： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = f_{1}^{\prime} \cdot \frac{\partial(x^{y})}{\partial x} + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot \frac{\partial(y^{x})}{\partial x} = f_{1}^{\prime} \cdot y x^{y-1} + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot y^{x} \ln y. 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ f(u,v) $ 是二元可微函数， $ z = f\left(\frac{y}{x}, \frac{x}{y}\right) $，则 $ x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = $ ___。
explanationMarkdown:
首先计算偏导数： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = f_{1}^{\prime} \cdot \left(-\frac{y}{x^{2}}\right) + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot \frac{1}{y}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = f_{1}^{\prime} \cdot \frac{1}{x} + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot \left(-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\right). 
$$
 代入表达式： 
$$
 x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = x\left(-\frac{y}{x^{2}}f_{1}^{\prime} + \frac{1}{y}f_{2}^{\prime}\right) - y\left(\frac{1}{x}f_{1}^{\prime} - \frac{x}{y^{2}}f_{2}^{\prime}\right) = -\frac{y}{x}f_{1}^{\prime} + \frac{x}{y}f_{2}^{\prime} - \frac{y}{x}f_{1}^{\prime} + \frac{x}{y}f_{2}^{\prime} = 2\left(-\frac{y}{x}f_{1}^{\prime} + \frac{x}{y}f_{2}^{\prime}\right). 
$$

contentMarkdown: 已知函数 $ f(u,v) $ 可微， $ z(x,y) = f(x + y, y - x) - f(xy, 2 - x) $，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(2,2)} - \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{(2,2)} = $ ___。
explanationMarkdown:
根据链式法则： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = f_{1}^{\prime}(x+y,y-x) - f_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,y-x) - y f_{1}^{\prime}(xy,2-x) + f_{2}^{\prime}(xy,2-x), 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = f_{1}^{\prime}(x+y,y-x) + f_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,y-x) - x f_{1}^{\prime}(xy,2-x). 
$$
 于是， 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -2f_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,y-x) + (x-y)f_{1}^{\prime}(xy,2-x) + f_{2}^{\prime}(xy,2-x). 
$$
 代入点 $ (2,2) $： 
$$
 \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(2,2)} - \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{(2,2)} = -2f_{2}^{\prime}(4,0) + f_{2}^{\prime}(4,0) = -f_{2}^{\prime}(4,0). 
$$
sourceText: 900 第四章数二 A 类 21

contentMarkdown:
设函数 $ f $ 与 $ g $ 均可微， $ z = f[xy, \ln x + g(xy)] $，则 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = $ ( )。

A. $ f_{1}^{\prime} $
B. $ f_{2}^{\prime} $
C. $ f_{1}^{\prime} + f_{2}^{\prime} $
D. $ f_{1}^{\prime} - f_{2}^{\prime} $
explanationMarkdown:
计算偏导数： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = f_{1}^{\prime} \cdot y + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot \left(\frac{1}{x} + g^{\prime} \cdot y\right), 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = f_{1}^{\prime} \cdot x + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot g^{\prime} \cdot x. 
$$
 代入表达式： 
$$
 x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = x\left[y f_{1}^{\prime} + f_{2}^{\prime}\left(\frac{1}{x} + y g^{\prime}\right)\right] - y\left[x f_{1}^{\prime} + x f_{2}^{\prime} g^{\prime}\right] = x y f_{1}^{\prime} + f_{2}^{\prime} + x y f_{2}^{\prime} g^{\prime} - x y f_{1}^{\prime} - x y f_{2}^{\prime} g^{\prime} = f_{2}^{\prime}. 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ f(u, v) $ 具有连续偏导数， $ z = f(xy, x + y) $。若 $ \left. \mathrm{d}z \right|_{x=2, y=3} = 6 \mathrm{d}x + 5 \mathrm{d}y $，则 $ f_{u}^{\prime}(6, 5) + f_{v}^{\prime}(6, 5) = $ ___。
explanationMarkdown:
计算偏导数： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = y f_{u}^{\prime}(xy, x+y) + f_{v}^{\prime}(xy, x+y), 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = x f_{u}^{\prime}(xy, x+y) + f_{v}^{\prime}(xy, x+y). 
$$
 由 $ \left.\mathrm{d}z\right|_{x=2, y=3} = 6\mathrm{d}x + 5\mathrm{d}y $，得 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{x=2, y=3}=6 $， $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{x=2, y=3}=5 $。代入得方程组： 
$$
 \begin{cases} 3f_{u}^{\prime}(6,5) + f_{v}^{\prime}(6,5) = 6, \\ 2f_{u}^{\prime}(6,5) + f_{v}^{\prime}(6,5) = 5. \end{cases} 
$$
 解得 $ f_{u}^{\prime}(6,5)=1 $， $ f_{v}^{\prime}(6,5)=3 $。因此， $ f_{u}^{\prime}(6,5) + f_{v}^{\prime}(6,5) = 4 $。

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ f(x, y) $ 可微，满足 $ \left( \frac{\partial f}{\partial x} \right)^2 + \left( \frac{\partial f}{\partial y} \right)^2 = 1 $， $ z(r, \theta) $ 为 $ f(x, y) $ 在极坐标系下的表示，则对单位圆周上的任一点 $ (1, \theta) $， $ \left( \frac{\partial z}{\partial r} \right)^2 + \left( \frac{\partial z}{\partial \theta} \right)^2 = $ ___.
explanationMarkdown:
在极坐标系下，$ x=r\cos\theta, y=r\sin\theta $。
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial r}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\frac{\partial x}{\partial r}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\frac{\partial y}{\partial r}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\cos\theta+\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\sin\theta, 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial\theta}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\frac{\partial x}{\partial\theta}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\frac{\partial y}{\partial\theta}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}(-r\sin\theta)+\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}r\cos\theta. 
$$
当 $ r=1 $ 时，
$$
 \begin{aligned}\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial r}\right)^{2}&+\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial\theta}\right)^{2}=\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\cos\theta+\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\sin\theta\right)^{2}+\left[\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}(-\sin\theta)+\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\cos\theta\right]^{2}\\&=\left(\cos^{2}\theta+\sin^{2}\theta\right)\left[\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right)^{2}+\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\right)^{2}\right]\\&=\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right)^{2}+\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\right)^{2}=1.\end{aligned} 
$$
sourceText: 900 第四章数二 B 类 20

contentMarkdown: 设可微函数 $ z = f(x, y) $ 在极坐标变换下满足 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial r} = r $，则 $ f_{x}^{\prime}(1,0) + f_{y}^{\prime}(0,1) = $ ___.
explanationMarkdown:
由极坐标变换 $ \left\{\begin{aligned} x &= r\cos\theta, \\ y &= r\sin\theta \end{aligned}\right. $ 和链式法则，可知
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial r}=f_{x}^{\prime}\frac{\partial x}{\partial r}+f_{y}^{\prime}\frac{\partial y}{\partial r}=\cos\theta f_{x}^{\prime}+\sin\theta f_{y}^{\prime}=r. 
$$
上式两端同乘 $ r $，可得 $ xf_{x}^{\prime} + yf_{y}^{\prime} = r^{2} $。
分别代入 $ (x,y)=(1,0) $， $ (x,y)=(0,1) $，可得 $ f_{x}^{\prime}(1,0)=1 $， $ f_{y}^{\prime}(0,1)=1 $。因此， $ f_{x}^{\prime}(1,0)+f_{y}^{\prime}(0,1)=2 $。
sourceText: 900 第四章数二 B 类 21

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ z = f(x, y) $ 在点 $ (1, 1) $ 处可微，且 $ f(1, 1) = 1 $， $ \left. \frac{\partial f}{\partial x} \right|_{(1,1)} = 2 $， $ \left. \frac{\partial f}{\partial y} \right|_{(1,1)} = 3 $， $ \varphi(x) = f[x, f(x, x)] $。求 $ \left. \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x} \varphi^{3}(x) \right|_{(x=1)} $。
explanationMarkdown: 第一步：求出 $ \frac{\mathrm{d}\varphi(x)}{\mathrm{d}x}\bigg|_{x=1} $。 $ \varphi(x)=f(x,\ f(x,\ x)) $。 $ \frac{\mathrm{d}\varphi(x)}{\mathrm{d}x} = f_{1}^{\prime}(x,\ f(x,\ x)) + f_{2}^{\prime}(x, f(x, x))\left[f_{1}^{\prime}(x, x) + f_{2}^{\prime}(x, x)\right] $。 $ \varphi(1) = f(1, f(1, 1)) = f(1, 1) = 1 $。所以 $ \left.\frac{\mathrm{d}\varphi(x)}{\mathrm{d}x}\right|_{x=1} = f_{1}^{\prime}(1, f(1, 1)) + f_{2}^{\prime}(1, f(1, 1)) [f_{1}^{\prime}(1, 1) + f_{2}^{\prime}(1, 1)] = f_{1}^{\prime}(1, 1) + f_{2}^{\prime}(1, 1) [f_{1}^{\prime}(1, 1) + f_{2}^{\prime}(1, 1)] = 2 + 3 \cdot (2 + 3) = 17 $。第二步：求出 $ \frac{\mathrm{d}[\varphi(x)]^{3}}{\mathrm{d}x}\bigg|_{x=1} $。 $ \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}[\varphi(x)]^{3}=3[\varphi(x)]^{2}\frac{\mathrm{d}\varphi(x)}{\mathrm{d}x} $。代入 x = 1 后，得出： $ \left.\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}[\varphi(x)]^{3}\right|_{x=1} =3[\varphi(1)]^{2}\cdot\left.\frac{\mathrm{d}\varphi(x)}{\mathrm{d}x}\right|_{x=1}=3\cdot1\cdot17 =51 $。
根据链式法则，$\varphi^{\prime}(1) = f_{1}^{\prime}(1,2) + f_{2}^{\prime}(1,2) \cdot 2 \left[ f_{1}^{\prime}(1,2) + 2 f_{2}^{\prime}(1,2) \right] = 2 + 3 \times 2 (2 + 2 \times 3) = 50$.

contentMarkdown: 已知函数 $ f(u,v) $ 可微，且 $ f(0,1)=0, f_{1}^{\prime}(0,1)=1, f_{2}^{\prime}(0,1)=2. $ 令 $ y(x)=f(f(x,\mathrm{e}^{x}),\mathrm{e}^{x}) $ 则 $ \left.\frac{dy}{dx}\right|_{x=0}= $ ___.
explanationMarkdown: 根据链式法则，$\left.\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right|_{x=0} = f_{1}^{\prime}(f(0,1),1) \cdot \left[ f_{1}^{\prime}(0,1) + f_{2}^{\prime}(0,1) \right] + f_{2}^{\prime}(f(0,1),1) = 3f_{1}^{\prime}(0,1) + f_{2}^{\prime}(0,1) = 5$.
sourceText: 900 第四章数二 A 类 19

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ f(x, y) $ 可微，且 $ f(0, 0) = 0 $， $ f_{1}^{\prime}(0, 0) = a $， $ f_{2}^{\prime}(0, 0) = b $。令 $ \varphi(t) = f(\sin t, f(\tan t, 1 - \cos t)) $，则 $ \varphi^{\prime}(0) = $ ___.
explanationMarkdown: 根据链式法则，$\varphi^{\prime}(t)=f_{1}^{\prime}(\sin t,f(\tan t,1-\cos t))\cos t + f_{2}^{\prime}(\sin t,f(\tan t,1-\cos t))\left[f_{1}^{\prime}(\tan t,1-\cos t)\sec^{2}t+f_{2}^{\prime}(\tan t,1-\cos t)\sin t\right]$。因此，$ \varphi^{\prime}(0)=f_{1}^{\prime}(0,f(0,0))+f_{2}^{\prime}(0,f(0,0))f_{1}^{\prime}(0,0)=a(1+b)$.
sourceText: 900 第四章数二 A 类 20

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ f(u, v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数， $ f(0,1) = 1 $ 是 $ f(u,v) $ 的极值， $ z = f(2x + y, f(x,y)) $。求 $ \left. \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} \right|_{(0,1)} $。
explanationMarkdown: 对 $ z = f(2x + y, f(x, y)) $ 两端关于 $x$ 求偏导数得 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=2f_{1}^{\prime}(2x+y,f(x,y))+f_{2}^{\prime}(2x+y,f(x,y))\cdot f_{1}^{\prime}(x,y)$。继续对上式两端关于 $y$ 求偏导数得 $\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=2f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(2x+y,f(x,y)\right)+2f_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(2x+y,f(x,y)\right)f_{2}^{\prime}(x,y)+\left[f_{21}^{\prime \prime}\left(2x+y,f(x,y)\right)+f_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(2x+y,f(x,y)\right)f_{2}^{\prime}(x,y)\right]f_{1}^{\prime}(x,y)+f_{2}^{\prime}\left(2x+y,f(x,y)\right)f_{12}^{\prime \prime}(x,y)$。由极值的必要条件可知 $ f_{1}^{\prime}(0,1)=f_{2}^{\prime}(0,1)=0 $。将 $ f(0,1)=1,f_{1}^{\prime}(0,1)=f_{2}^{\prime}(0,1)=0 $ 代入上式可得 $\left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{(0,1)}=2f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(1,1\right)+f_{2}^{\prime}\left(1,1\right)f_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(0,1\right)$.
sourceText: 900 第四章数二 A 类 33

contentMarkdown:
已知函数 $ f(u, v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数， $ f(1, 1) = 1 $ 是 $ f(x, y) $ 的极值，且 $ z = f[xy, f(x, y)] $，则 $ \left. \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} \right|_{(1,1)} = (\quad) $.

A. $ f_{uu}^{\prime\prime}(1,1)+f_{vv}^{\prime\prime}(1,1) $
B. $ 2f_{uv}^{\prime\prime}(1,1) $
C. 0
D. $ f_{uu}^{\prime\prime}(1,1) $
explanationMarkdown: 由题，复合函数 $ z = f[xy, f(x, y)] $ 的复合结构图（略）。$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=f_{1}^{\prime}\left[x y,f(x,y)\right]\cdot y+f_{2}^{\prime}\left[x y,f(x,y)\right]\cdot f_{1}^{\prime}(x,y)$。$\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=\{f_{11}^{\prime\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]\cdot x+f_{12}^{\prime\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]\cdot f_{2}^{\prime}(x,y)\}y+f_{1}^{\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]+\{f_{21}^{\prime\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]x+f_{22}^{\prime\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]\cdot f_{2}^{\prime}(x,y)\}f_{1}^{\prime}(x,y)+f_{2}^{\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]\cdot f_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)$。由于 $ f(1,1)=1 $ 是极值，故 $ f_{1}^{\prime}(1,1)=f_{2}^{\prime}(1,1)=0 $，于是 $\left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{(1,1)}=f^{\prime \prime}_{11}(1,1)=f^{\prime \prime}_{uu}(1,1)$.

contentMarkdown: 设 $ z = f(2x - y) + g(x, xy) $，其中函数 $ f(t) $ 二阶可导， $ g(u, v) $ 具有连续二阶偏导数，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} $。
explanationMarkdown:
首先计算一阶偏导数： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = f^{\prime}(2x - y) \cdot 2 + g_{1}^{\prime}(x, xy) \cdot 1 + g_{2}^{\prime}(x, xy) \cdot y = 2f^{\prime}(2x - y) + g_{1}^{\prime}(x, xy) + y g_{2}^{\prime}(x, xy). 
$$
 然后对 $ y $ 求偏导： 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x \partial y} = \frac{\partial}{\partial y}\left[2f^{\prime}(2x - y) + g_{1}^{\prime}(x, xy) + y g_{2}^{\prime}(x, xy)\right] = 2f^{\prime\prime}(2x - y) \cdot (-1) + \left[g_{11}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy) \cdot 0 + g_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy) \cdot x\right] + g_{2}^{\prime}(x, xy) \cdot 1 + y \left[g_{21}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy) \cdot 0 + g_{22}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy) \cdot x\right] = -2f^{\prime\prime}(2x - y) + x g_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy) + g_{2}^{\prime}(x, xy) + x y g_{22}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy). 
$$
 由于 $ g $ 具有连续二阶偏导数， $ g_{12}^{\prime\prime} = g_{21}^{\prime\prime} $，最终结果为： 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x \partial y} = -2f^{\prime\prime}(2x - y) + g_{2}^{\prime}(x, xy) + x g_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy) + x y g_{22}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy). 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ z = f(2x - y, y \sin x) $，其中 $ f $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} $。
answerMarkdown: $\displaystyle \frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial x\partial y}=-2\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial u^2}+(2\sin x-y\cos x)\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial u\partial v}+y\sin x\cos x\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial v^2}+\cos x\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}$，其中各偏导均在 $(u,v)=(2x-y,y\sin x)$ 处取值。
explanationMarkdown:
令 $u=2x-y$，$v=y\sin x$，则 $z=f(u,v)$。先对 $x$ 求偏导：
$$
z_x=2f_u+y\cos x\,f_v.
$$
再对 $y$ 求偏导，利用 $u_y=-1$、$v_y=\sin x$ 以及 $f_{uv}=f_{vu}$，得
$$
\frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial x\partial y}=-2f_{uu}+(2\sin x-y\cos x)f_{uv}+y\sin x\cos x\,f_{vv}+\cos x\,f_v.
$$
这里 $f_u,f_v,f_{uu},f_{uv},f_{vv}$ 均表示 $f$ 对相应变量的偏导，并在 $(2x-y,y\sin x)$ 处取值。

contentMarkdown: 设 $ z = f\left(\mathrm{e}^{x} \sin y, x^{2} + y^{2}\right) $，其中 $ f $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} $。
answerMarkdown: $\displaystyle \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=\mathrm{e}^{2x}\sin y\cos y\,f_{11}^{\prime\prime}+2\mathrm{e}^{x}(y\sin y+x\cos y)f_{12}^{\prime\prime}+4xyf_{22}^{\prime\prime}+\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y\,f_{1}^{\prime}$，其中各偏导均在 $\left(\mathrm{e}^{x}\sin y,x^{2}+y^{2}\right)$ 处取值。
explanationMarkdown:
首先，$ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \mathrm{e}^{x}\sin y \cdot f_{1}^{\prime} + 2x \cdot f_{2}^{\prime} $。
然后，$ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = \frac{\partial}{\partial y}\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right) = f_{1}^{\prime}\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y + \mathrm{e}^{x}\sin y \left( f_{11}^{\prime\prime}\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y + 2f_{12}^{\prime\prime}y \right) + 2x \left( f_{21}^{\prime\prime}\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y + 2f_{22}^{\prime\prime}y \right) $。
由于 $ f $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，$ f_{12}^{\prime\prime} = f_{21}^{\prime\prime} $，整理得：$ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = f_{11}^{\prime\prime}\mathrm{e}^{2x}\sin y\cos y + 2\mathrm{e}^{x}f_{12}^{\prime\prime}(y\sin y + x\cos y) + 4xyf_{22}^{\prime\prime} + f_{1}^{\prime}\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y $。

contentMarkdown: 设 $ z = \sin(xy) + \varphi\left(x, \frac{x}{y}\right) $，其中 $ \varphi(u, v) $ 有二阶偏导数，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x \partial y} $。
answerMarkdown: $\displaystyle \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=\cos(xy)-xy\sin(xy)-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\varphi_{uv}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{1}{y^{2}}\varphi_{v}^{\prime}-\frac{x}{y^{3}}\varphi_{vv}^{\prime\prime}$，其中 $\varphi$ 的各偏导均在 $\left(x,\frac{x}{y}\right)$ 处取值。
explanationMarkdown:
首先，$ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = y\cos(xy) + \varphi_{u}^{\prime} + \frac{1}{y}\varphi_{v}^{\prime} $。
然后，$ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = \frac{\partial}{\partial y}\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right) = \cos(xy) - xy\sin(xy) + \left(-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\right)\varphi_{uv}^{\prime\prime} + \left(-\frac{1}{y^{2}}\right)\varphi_{v}^{\prime} + \frac{1}{y}\left(-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\right)\varphi_{vv}^{\prime\prime} $。
整理得：$ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = \cos(xy) - xy\sin(xy) - \frac{x}{y^{2}}\varphi_{uv}^{\prime\prime} - \frac{1}{y^{2}}\varphi_{v}^{\prime} - \frac{x}{y^{3}}\varphi_{vv}^{\prime\prime} $。

contentMarkdown: 设 $ z = f\left(xy, \frac{x}{y}\right) + g\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) $，其中 $ f $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，$ g $ 具有二阶连续导数，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} $。
answerMarkdown: $\displaystyle \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=f_{1}^{\prime}-\frac{1}{y^{2}}f_{2}^{\prime}+xyf_{11}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{x}{y^{3}}f_{22}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{1}{x^{2}}g^{\prime}-\frac{y}{x^{3}}g^{\prime\prime}$，其中 $f$ 的各偏导在 $\left(xy,\frac{x}{y}\right)$ 处取值，$g$ 的导数在 $\frac{y}{x}$ 处取值。
explanationMarkdown:
首先，$ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = y f_{1}^{\prime} + \frac{1}{y} f_{2}^{\prime} - \frac{y}{x^{2}} g^{\prime} $。
然后，$ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = \frac{\partial}{\partial y}\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right) = f_{1}^{\prime} + y\left( x f_{11}^{\prime\prime} - \frac{x}{y^{2}} f_{12}^{\prime\prime} \right) - \frac{1}{y^{2}} f_{2}^{\prime} + \frac{1}{y}\left( x f_{21}^{\prime\prime} - \frac{x}{y^{2}} f_{22}^{\prime\prime} \right) - \frac{1}{x^{2}} g^{\prime} - \frac{y}{x^{2}} g^{\prime\prime} \cdot \frac{1}{x} $。
由于 $ f $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，$ f_{12}^{\prime\prime} = f_{21}^{\prime\prime} $，整理得：$ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = f_{1}^{\prime} - \frac{1}{y^{2}} f_{2}^{\prime} + x y f_{11}^{\prime\prime} - \frac{x}{y^{3}} f_{22}^{\prime\prime} - \frac{1}{x^{2}} g^{\prime} - \frac{y}{x^{3}} g^{\prime\prime} $。

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ f(u,v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，$ z = f(x, xy) $，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} $。
explanationMarkdown:
**第一步：求对 $x$ 的一阶偏导数**

由链式法则：
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=f^{\prime}_1 + f^{\prime}_2 \cdot \frac{\partial(xy)}{\partial x}=f^{\prime}_1 + f^{\prime}_2 \cdot y. 
$$

**第二步：求对 $y$ 的二阶偏导数**

对 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}$ 再对 $y$ 求偏导：
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = \frac{\partial}{\partial y}(f^{\prime}_1) + \frac{\partial}{\partial y}(y f^{\prime}_2). 
$$
计算各项：
$$
 \frac{\partial}{\partial y}(f^{\prime}_1) = f_{12}^{\prime\prime} \cdot \frac{\partial(xy)}{\partial y} = f_{12}^{\prime\prime} \cdot x. 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial}{\partial y}(y f^{\prime}_2) = f^{\prime}_2 + y \cdot \frac{\partial}{\partial y}(f^{\prime}_2) = f^{\prime}_2 + y \cdot (f_{22}^{\prime\prime} \cdot \frac{\partial(xy)}{\partial y}) = f^{\prime}_2 + xy f_{22}^{\prime\prime}. 
$$
合并得：
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = f_{12}^{\prime\prime} \cdot x + f^{\prime}_2 + xy f_{22}^{\prime\prime} = (f_{12}^{\prime\prime} + y f_{22}^{\prime\prime})x + f^{\prime}_2. 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ z = f(x + y, x - y, xy) $，其中 $f$ 具有二阶连续偏导数，求 $dz$ 与 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} $。
answerMarkdown: $\displaystyle \mathrm{d}z=(f_{1}^{\prime}+f_{2}^{\prime}+yf_{3}^{\prime})\mathrm{d}x+(f_{1}^{\prime}-f_{2}^{\prime}+xf_{3}^{\prime})\mathrm{d}y$；$\displaystyle \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=f_{11}^{\prime\prime}+f_{3}^{\prime}+(x+y)f_{13}^{\prime\prime}-f_{22}^{\prime\prime}+(x-y)f_{23}^{\prime\prime}+xyf_{33}^{\prime\prime}$。各偏导均在 $(x+y,x-y,xy)$ 处取值。
explanationMarkdown:
记中间变量：$ u_1 = x + y $，$ u_2 = x - y $，$ u_3 = xy $。

**第一步：求一阶偏导数 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} $，$ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $ 和 $dz$**

由链式法则：
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=f_{1}^{\prime}\frac{\partial(x+y)}{\partial x}+f_{2}^{\prime}\frac{\partial(x-y)}{\partial x}+f_{3}^{\prime}\frac{\partial(xy)}{\partial x}=f_{1}^{\prime}\cdot1+f_{2}^{\prime}\cdot1+yf_{3}^{\prime}=f_{1}^{\prime}+f_{2}^{\prime}+yf_{3}^{\prime}. 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=f_{1}^{\prime}\frac{\partial(x+y)}{\partial y}+f_{2}^{\prime}\frac{\partial(x-y)}{\partial y}+f_{3}^{\prime}\frac{\partial(xy)}{\partial y}=f_{1}^{\prime}\cdot1-f_{2}^{\prime}\cdot1+xf_{3}^{\prime}=f_{1}^{\prime}-f_{2}^{\prime}+xf_{3}^{\prime}. 
$$
则全微分为：
$$
 dz=\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}dx+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}dy=(f_{1}^{\prime}+f_{2}^{\prime}+yf_{3}^{\prime})dx+(f_{1}^{\prime}-f_{2}^{\prime}+xf_{3}^{\prime})dy. 
$$

**第二步：求二阶偏导数 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} $**

由 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=f_{1}^{\prime}+f_{2}^{\prime}+yf_{3}^{\prime} $，对 $y$ 求偏导：
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=\frac{\partial f_{1}^{\prime}}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial f_{2}^{\prime}}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial(y f_{3}^{\prime})}{\partial y}. 
$$
分别计算（注意 $f$ 二阶偏导连续，故混合偏导相等）：
$$
 \frac{\partial f_{1}^{\prime}}{\partial y}=f_{11}^{\prime\prime}\cdot1+f_{12}^{\prime\prime}\cdot(-1)+f_{13}^{\prime\prime}\cdot x = f_{11}^{\prime\prime} - f_{12}^{\prime\prime} + x f_{13}^{\prime\prime}. 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial f_{2}^{\prime}}{\partial y}=f_{21}^{\prime\prime}\cdot1+f_{22}^{\prime\prime}\cdot(-1)+f_{23}^{\prime\prime}\cdot x = f_{21}^{\prime\prime} - f_{22}^{\prime\prime} + x f_{23}^{\prime\prime}. 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial(y f_{3}^{\prime})}{\partial y}=f_{3}^{\prime} + y \cdot \frac{\partial f_{3}^{\prime}}{\partial y} = f_{3}^{\prime} + y(f_{31}^{\prime\prime}\cdot1+f_{32}^{\prime\prime}\cdot(-1)+f_{33}^{\prime\prime}\cdot x) = f_{3}^{\prime} + y f_{31}^{\prime\prime} - y f_{32}^{\prime\prime} + xy f_{33}^{\prime\prime}. 
$$
合并，并利用 $f_{12}^{\prime\prime}=f_{21}^{\prime\prime}$，$f_{13}^{\prime\prime}=f_{31}^{\prime\prime}$，$f_{23}^{\prime\prime}=f_{32}^{\prime\prime}$ 进行化简：
$$
 \begin{aligned} \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} &= (f_{11}^{\prime\prime} - f_{12}^{\prime\prime} + x f_{13}^{\prime\prime}) + (f_{21}^{\prime\prime} - f_{22}^{\prime\prime} + x f_{23}^{\prime\prime}) + (f_{3}^{\prime} + y f_{31}^{\prime\prime} - y f_{32}^{\prime\prime} + xy f_{33}^{\prime\prime}) \\ &= f_{11}^{\prime\prime} + f_{3}^{\prime} + (x+y)f_{13}^{\prime\prime} - f_{22}^{\prime\prime} + (x-y)f_{23}^{\prime\prime} + xy f_{33}^{\prime\prime}. \end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ f(u,v) $ 具有 2 阶连续偏导数，函数 $ g(x,y)=xy-f(x+y,x-y) $。求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}} $
explanationMarkdown:
令 $ u=x+y, v=x-y $，则 $ g(x,y)=xy-f(u,v) $。

$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial x}=y-(f'_u+f'_v) 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}=-(f''_{uu}+2f''_{uv}+f''_{vv}) 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}=1-(f''_{uu}-f''_{vv}) 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial y}=x-(f'_u-f'_v) 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=-(f''_{uu}-2f''_{uv}+f''_{vv}) 
$$

将以上三式相加得：
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=1-3f''_{uu}-f''_{vv} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ f(u, v) $ 具有 2 阶连续偏导数，且 $ \left. \mathrm{d}f \right|_{(1,1)} = 3 \mathrm{d}u + 4 \mathrm{d}v $. 令 $ y = f(\cos x, 1+x^{2}) $，则 $ \left.\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\right|_{x=0}= $ ___.
explanationMarkdown:
由 $ \left.\mathrm{d}f\right|_{(1,1)}=3\mathrm{d}u+4\mathrm{d}v $，知 $ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\right|_{(1,1)}=3,\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\right|_{(1,1)}=4 $。

因为 $ y = f(\cos x, 1 + x^{2}) $，所以

$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\cdot(-\sin x)+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\cdot(2x) 
$$

$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}y}{\mathrm{d}x^{2}}=&-\cos x\cdot\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}-\sin x\cdot\left[\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}\cdot(-\sin x)+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v\partial u}\cdot(2x)\right]\\&+2\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}+2x\left[\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}\cdot(-\sin x)+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}}\cdot(2x)\right].\end{aligned} 
$$

将 $ x=0 $ 代入，得 $ \left.\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\right|_{x=0}=-\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\right|_{(1,1)}+2\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\right|_{(1,1)}=-3+8=5 $。

contentMarkdown:
已知函数 $ f(u, v) $ 具有 2 阶连续偏导数，且函数 $ g(x, y) = f(2x + y, 3x - y) $ 满足 $ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}-6\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=1 $。
(Ⅰ) 求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v} $；
（Ⅱ）若 $ \frac{\partial f(u,0)}{\partial u}=u\mathrm{e}^{-u},\quad f(0,v)=\frac{1}{50}v^{2}-1 $，求 $ f(u,v) $的表达式。
explanationMarkdown:
（Ⅰ）记 $ u=2x+y,\quad v=3x-y $，由 $ g(x,y)=f(2x+y,3x-y) $求导得

$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial x}=2\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}+3\frac{\partial f}{\partial v},\quad \frac{\partial g}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}-\frac{\partial f}{\partial v} 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}=4\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}+12\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}+9\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}} 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}=2\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}-3\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}} 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}} 
$$

代入 $ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}-6\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=1 $，并整理得 $ 25\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}=1 $，即 $ \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}=\frac{1}{25} $。

（Ⅱ）由（Ⅰ）知 $ \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}=\frac{1}{25} $，所以

$$
 \frac{\partial f}{\partial u}=\frac{1}{25}v+C(u),\quad f(u,\quad v)=\frac{1}{25}uv+\int C(u)\mathrm{d}u+C_{0}(v) 
$$

记 $ f(u,v)=\frac{1}{25}uv+h_{1}(u)+h_{2}(v) $。

由题设 $ \frac{\partial f(u,0)}{\partial u}=u\mathrm{e}^{-u} $可知 $ h_{1}^{\prime}(u)=u\mathrm{e}^{-u} $。

由题设 $ f(0, v)=\frac{1}{50}v^{2}-1 $ 可知 $ h_{2}(v)+h_{1}(0)=\frac{1}{50}v^{2}-1 $。

又由 $ h_{1}^{\prime}(u)=u\mathrm{e}^{-u} $ 得 $ h_{1}(u)-h_{1}(0)=-(u+1)\mathrm{e}^{-u}+1 $。

所以 $ h_{1}(u)+h_{2}(v)=-(u+1)\mathrm{e}^{-u}+\frac{1}{50}v^{2} $。

综上可知， $ f(u,v)=\frac{1}{25}uv+\frac{1}{50}v^{2}-(u+1)e^{-u} $。

（Ⅰ）由 $ z = xy - w $，有
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=y-\frac{\partial w}{\partial u}\bullet\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial w}{\partial v}\bullet\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=y-\frac{\partial w}{\partial u}-\frac{\partial w}{\partial v}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=x-\frac{\partial w}{\partial u}\bullet\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial w}{\partial v}\bullet\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}=x-\frac{\partial w}{\partial u}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial v}, 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}&=-\frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial u^{2}}\bullet\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial u\partial v}\bullet\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial v\partial u}\bullet\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial v^{2}}\bullet\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\\&=-\frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial u^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial u\partial v}-\frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial v^{2}},\end{aligned} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}&=1-\frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial u^{2}}\bullet\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial u\partial v}\bullet\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial v\partial u}\bullet\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial v^{2}}\bullet\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\\&=1-\frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial u^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial v^{2}},\end{aligned} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}&=-\frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial u^{2}}\bullet\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial u\partial v}\bullet\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial v\partial u}\bullet\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial v^{2}}\bullet\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\\&=-\frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial u^{2}}+2\frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial u\partial v}-\frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial v^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
代入原方程，得
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=2-4\frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial u^{2}}=0, 
$$
 
故 $ \frac{\partial^{2}w}{\partial u^{2}}=\frac{1}{2}. $
(Ⅱ)
$$
 \frac{\partial w}{\partial u}=\int\frac{1}{2}\mathrm{d}u+\varphi_{1}(v)=\frac{1}{2}u+\varphi_{1}(v), 
$$
 
由 $ \frac{\partial w(0,v)}{\partial u}=v\mathrm{e}^{-v} $，得 $ \varphi_{1}(v)=v\mathrm{e}^{-v} $，故
$$
 \frac{\partial w}{\partial u}=\frac{1}{2}u+v\mathrm{e}^{-v},\quad w=\int\left(\frac{1}{2}u+v\mathrm{e}^{-v}\right)\mathrm{d}u+\varphi_{2}(v)=\frac{u^{2}}{4}+u v\mathrm{e}^{-v}+\varphi_{2}(v). 
$$
 
由 $ w(0,v)=\frac{v^{2}}{4} $，得 $ \varphi_{2}(v)=\frac{v^{2}}{4} $，故
$$
 w=\frac{u^{2}}{4}+u v\mathrm{e}^{-v}+\frac{v^{2}}{4}. 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}z&=xy-w=xy-\left[\frac{(x+y)^{2}}{4}+(x+y)(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{-(x-y)}+\frac{(x-y)^{2}}{4}\right]\\&=xy-\frac{1}{2}(x^{2}+y^{2})-(x^{2}-y^{2})\mathrm{e}^{-(x-y)}.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ f(x, y) $ 有二阶连续偏导数, 满足 $ f_{xx}^{\prime\prime}(x, y) = f_{yy}^{\prime\prime}(x, y) $, $ f(x, 2x) = x^2 $, $ f_x^{\prime}(x, 2x) = x $, 则 $ f_{xx}^{\prime\prime}(x, 2x) = $ ___ $ f_{xy}^{\prime\prime}(x, 2x) = $ ___.
explanationMarkdown:
$ f(x,2x)=x^{2} $两端对x求导，得 $ f_{x}^{\prime}(x,2x)+2f_{y}^{\prime}(x,2x)=2x $，故 $ f_{y}^{\prime}(x,2x)=\frac{x}{2} $。
$ f_{x}^{\prime}(x,2x)=x $ 两端对 x 求导，得 $ f_{xx}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)+2f_{xy}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)=1 $。
$ f_{y}^{\prime}(x,2x)=\frac{x}{2} $ 两端对 x 求导，得 $ f_{xy}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)+2f_{yy}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)=\frac{1}{2} $。
由 $ f_{xx}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)=f_{yy}^{\prime\prime}(x,y) $， $ f_{xy}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)=f_{yx}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x) $，得 $ f_{xx}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)=0 $， $ f_{xy}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)=\frac{1}{2} $。
sourceText: 1998 年江苏省高等数学竞赛题

contentMarkdown: 设有二阶连续偏导数的函数 $ u = u(s, t) $ 满足 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial s^{2}} = -\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial t^{2}} $ 以及 $ u(x, 2x) = x^{2} $, $ u_{1}^{\prime}(x, 2x) = 4x $. 求 $ u_{11}^{\prime\prime}(x, 2x) $ 和 $ u_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x, 2x) $.
explanationMarkdown:
由 $ u(x,2x)=x^{2} $ 可得， $ u_{1}^{\prime}(x,2x)+2u_{2}^{\prime}(x,2x)=2x. $ 代入 $ u_{1}^{\prime}(x,2x)=4x $ ，解得 $ u_{2}^{\prime}(x,2x)=\frac{2x-4x}{2}=-x. $
对 $ u_{1}^{\prime}(x,2x)=4x,u_{2}^{\prime}(x,2x)=-x $ 两端同时关于 x 求导得
$$
 \begin{cases}u_{11}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)+2u_{12}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)=4,\\u_{21}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)+2u_{22}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)=-1.\end{cases} 
$$
 
由于 u 的二阶偏导数连续，故 $ u_{21}^{\prime\prime} = u_{12}^{\prime\prime} $。又由已知条件知 $ u_{22}^{\prime\prime} = -u_{11}^{\prime\prime} $，代入上式得
$$
 \left\{\begin{aligned}u_{11}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)+2u_{12}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)&=4,\\ u_{12}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)-2u_{11}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)&=-1.\end{aligned}\right. 
$$
 
解得 $ u_{11}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)=\frac{6}{5},u_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)=\frac{7}{5}. $
sourceText: 900 第四章数二 B 类 27

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ z = f(x \cos y, y g(x)) $，其中函数 $ f $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且 $ f_{12}''(1,0) = 1 $，函数 $ g(x) $ 可导，且在 $ x = 1 $ 处取得极值 $ g(1) = 2 $。求 $ \left. \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} \right|_{x=1\atop y=0} $。
explanationMarkdown:
由链式法则，
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}&=f_{1}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)\frac{\partial\left(x\cos y\right)}{\partial x}+f_{2}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)\frac{\partial\left[yg(x)\right]}{\partial x}\\&=\cos yf_{1}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)+yg^{\prime}(x)f_{2}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right),\\\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}&=\frac{\partial\left[\cos yf_{1}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)+yg^{\prime}(x)f_{2}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)\right]}{\partial y}\\&=-\sin yf_{1}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)+\cos y\left[f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)\cdot\left(-x\sin y\right)\right.\\&\left.\quad+f_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)g(x)\right]+g^{\prime}(x)f_{2}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)\\&\quad+yg^{\prime}(x)\left[f_{21}^{\prime \prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)\cdot\left(-x\sin y\right)+f_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)g(x)\right]\end{aligned} 
$$
 
由 $ g(x) $ 可导且在 $ x = 1 $ 处取得极值 $ g(1) = 2 $ 知， $ g'(1) = 0 $。将 $ x = 1, y = 0, g(1) = 2, g'(1) = 0 $ 代入 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} $，得
$$
 \left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{\substack{x=1\\ y=0}}=2f_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(1,0\right)=2. 
$$
sourceText: 900 第四章数二 A 类 32

contentMarkdown: 设 $ z = e^{xy} + f(x + y, xy) $， $ f(u, v) $ 有二阶连续偏导数，则 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} = $ ___.
explanationMarkdown:
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=y e^{xy}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}+y\frac{\partial f}{\partial v} 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=e^{xy}+xye^{xy}+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}+x\cdot\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}+y\cdot\left(\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v\partial u}+x\cdot\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}}\right) 
$$
 
$$
 =e^{xy}+xye^{xy}+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}+(x+y)\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}+xy\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ f(u,v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且满足 $ 4\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}-\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}}=1 $，又 $ g(x,y)=f(x^{2}+y^{2},xy) $，则 $ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}-\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}= $ ___.
explanationMarkdown:
$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\cdot2x+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\cdot y 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}&=2\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}+2x\left(\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}\cdot2x+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}\cdot y\right)+y\left(\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v\partial u}\cdot2x+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}}\cdot y\right)\\&=2\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}+4x^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}+4xy\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}+y^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}}\end{aligned} 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=2\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}+4y^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}+4xy\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}+x^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}} 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}-\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=4(x^{2}-y^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}-(x^{2}-y^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}}=(x^{2}-y^{2})\left(4\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}-\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}}\right)=x^{2}-y^{2}. 
$$
sourceText: 25 版 660 数一二三第 93 题

contentMarkdown: 设 $ z = f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) + g\left(\mathrm{e}^{x}, \sin y\right) $， $ f $ 有二阶连续导数， $ g $ 有二阶连续偏导数，则 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = $ ___.
explanationMarkdown:
依题设，有
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{y}{x^{2}}f^{\prime}+\mathrm{e}^{x}g_{1}^{\prime}, 
$$
 
故
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=-\frac{1}{x^{2}}f^{\prime}-\frac{y}{x^{3}}f^{\prime\prime}+\mathrm{e}^{x}g_{12}^{\prime\prime}\cos y. 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ f(u,v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，函数 $ g(x,y)=x^{2}+y^{2}-f(x+y,xy) $。求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}} $。
explanationMarkdown:
由于函数 $ f(u,v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，故 $ f_{12}^{\prime\prime}(u,v)=f_{21}^{\prime\prime}(u,v) $。分别计算 $ \frac{\partial g}{\partial x},\frac{\partial g}{\partial y},\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}},\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}},\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y} $。
$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial x}=2x-f_{1}^{\prime}(x+y,xy)-yf_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,xy), 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial y}=2y-f_{1}^{\prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-xf_{2}^{\prime}\left(x+y,xy\right), 
$$
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}&=2-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-yf_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-y\left[f_{21}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)+yf_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)\right]\\&=2-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-2yf_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-y^{2}f_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right),\end{align*} 
$$
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}&=-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)-xf_{12}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)-y\big[f_{21}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)+xf_{22}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)\big]-f_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,xy)\\&=-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)-(x+y)f_{12}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)-xyf_{22}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)-f_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,xy),\end{align*} 
$$
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}&=2-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-xf_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-x\left[f_{21}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)+xf_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)\right]\\&=2-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-2xf_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-x^{2}f_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right).\end{aligned} 
$$
代入 $ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}} $ 可得，
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=4-\left(x-y\right)^{2}f_{22}^{\prime\prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)+2f_{2}^{\prime}\left(x+y,xy\right). 
$$
sourceText: 900 第四章数二 A 类 34

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ f(u,v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，函数 $ g(x,y)=xy-f\left(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\right) $，求 $ x^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}+2xy\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+y^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}} $
explanationMarkdown:
由题，函数复合关系如图所示，所以 
$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial x}=y-f_{u}^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\right)\left(-\frac{y}{x^{2}}\right)-f_{v}^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\right)\frac{1}{y}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial y}=x-f_{u}^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\right)\frac{1}{x}-f_{v}^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\right)\left(-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\right), 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}&=\frac{y}{x^{2}}\Big[f_{u u}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\Big(-\frac{y}{x^{2}}\Big)+f_{u v}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\frac{1}{y}\Big]+f_{u}^{\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\Big(-\frac{2y}{x^{3}}\Big)-\\&\quad\frac{1}{y}\Big[f_{v u}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\Big(-\frac{y}{x^{2}}\Big)+f_{v v}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\frac{1}{y}\Big]\\&=-\frac{y^{2}}{x^{4}}f_{u u}^{\prime\prime}+\frac{2}{x^{2}}f_{u v}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{1}{y^{2}}f_{v v}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{2y}{x^{3}}f_{u}^{\prime},\end{aligned} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}&=1+f_{u}^{\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\frac{1}{x^{2}}+\frac{y}{x^{2}}\Big[f_{uu}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\frac{1}{x}+f_{uv}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\Big(-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\Big)\Big]+\\&\quad\frac{1}{y^{2}}f_{v}^{\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)-\frac{1}{y}\Big[f_{v u}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\frac{1}{x}-\frac{x}{y^{2}}f_{v v}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\Big]\\&=1+\frac{y}{x^{3}}f_{uu}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{2}{xy}f_{uv}^{\prime\prime}+\frac{x}{y^{3}}f_{v v}^{\prime\prime}+\frac{1}{x^{2}}f_{u}^{\prime}+\frac{1}{y^{2}}f_{v}^{\prime},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}&=-\frac{1}{x}\Big[f_{uu}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\frac{1}{x}+f_{uv}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\Big(-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\Big)\Big]-\frac{2x}{y^{3}}f_{v}^{\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)+\\&\quad\frac{x}{y^{2}}\Big[f_{v u}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\frac{1}{x}-\frac{x}{y^{2}}f_{v v}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\Big]\\&=-\frac{1}{x^{2}}f_{uu}^{\prime\prime}+\frac{2}{y^{2}}f_{uv}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{x^{2}}{y^{4}}f_{v v}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{2x}{y^{3}}f_{v}^{\prime},\end{aligned} 
$$
 故 
$$
 x^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}+2xy\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+y^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=2xy. 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ f(u) = \ln u, u = \sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2}} $，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial x^{2}} + \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial y^{2}} + \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial z^{2}} $.
explanationMarkdown:
由题可得， 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial x}&=\frac{1}{u}\cdot\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}}}\cdot\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}}}\\&=\frac{x}{x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}},\end{aligned} 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial x^{2}}=\frac{\partial}{\partial x}\Big(\frac{x}{x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}}\Big)=\frac{y^{2}+z^{2}-x^{2}}{(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2})^{2}}. 
$$
 由变量对称性，有 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial y^{2}}=\frac{z^{2}+x^{2}-y^{2}}{(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2})^{2}}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial z^{2}}=\frac{x^{2}+y^{2}-z^{2}}{(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2})^{2}}, 
$$
 故得 $ \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial y^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial z^{2}}=\frac{1}{x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}}. $

contentMarkdown: 设 $f$ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且$$u=f(x^2+y,xy)$$则 $u_{xy}''=\underline{\hspace{5em}}$。

若二元函数 $ f(x,y) $ 存在二阶连续偏导数，且满足 $ f(x,y) = -f(y,x) $，则下列结论中，错误的是()

A. $ f_{11}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)=f_{22}^{\prime\prime}(x,y). $
B. $ f_{11}^{\prime \prime}(x,y)=-f_{22}^{\prime \prime}(y,x). $
C. $ f_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)=f_{21}^{\prime\prime}(x,y). $
D. $ f_{12}''(x,y) = -f_{21}''(y,x). $
explanationMarkdown: 记 $ u = f(x, y) $, $ v = f(y, x) $, 则 $ u = -v $, $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}} = -\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}} $, $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x \partial y} = -\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x \partial y} $. 分别计算 u, v 的一阶、二阶偏导数: $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=f_{1}^{\prime}\left(x,y\right),\quad\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}=f_{11}^{\prime\prime}\left(x,y\right),\quad\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}=f_{12}^{\prime\prime}\left(x,y\right) $, $ \frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=f_{2}^{\prime}(y,x),\quad\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}=f_{22}^{\prime \prime}(y,x),\quad\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x\partial y}=f_{21}^{\prime \prime}(y,x) $. 于是， $ f_{11}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)=-f_{22}^{\prime\prime}(y,x) $， $ f_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)=-f_{21}^{\prime\prime}(y,x) $。选项B和选项D正确。由于 $ f(x,y) $存在二阶连续偏导数，故 $ f_{12}''(x,y)=f_{21}''(x,y) $。选项C正确。由排除法可知，应选 A. 下面举例说明选项 A 错误: 例如， $ f(x,y)=x^{3}-y^{3} $ 满足题干要求，但 $ f_{11}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)=6x,f_{22}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)=-6y,f_{11}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)\neq f_{22}^{\prime\prime}(x,y) $.

contentMarkdown: 已知  $ z = f(u, v) $,  $ u = x + y $,  $ v = xy $, 且  $ f(u, v) $ 的二阶偏导数都连续. 求  $ \frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial x \partial y} $.
answerMarkdown: $\displaystyle f_{uu}+(x+y)f_{uv}+xyf_{vv}+f_v$，其中各偏导数均在 $(u,v)=(x+y,xy)$ 处取值。
explanationMarkdown:
由 $u=x+y$、$v=xy$，先对 $x$ 求偏导：

$$z_x=f_u+yf_v.$$

再对 $y$ 求偏导，注意 $u_y=1$、$v_y=x$：

$$
z_{xy}=(f_u)_y+(yf_v)_y=(f_{uu}+xf_{uv})+f_v+y(f_{vu}+xf_{vv})=f_{uu}+(x+y)f_{uv}+xyf_{vv}+f_v.
$$

因二阶偏导数连续，$f_{uv}=f_{vu}$；各偏导数均在 $(u,v)=(x+y,xy)$ 处取值。

contentMarkdown: 已知函数 $ u(x,y) $ 满足 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}+3\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-4\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=0 $，求 $ a,b $ 的值，使得在变换 $ u(x,y)=v(x,y)e^{ax+by} $ 下，上述等式可化为不含 $ v(x,y) $ 的一阶偏导数的等式。
explanationMarkdown:
由 $ u(x,y)=v(x,y)\mathrm{e}^{ax+by} $ 可得，
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\cdot\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}+\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\cdot av=\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+av\right). 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\cdot\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}+\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\cdot b v=\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+b v\right). 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}=a\cdot\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+av\right)+\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}+a\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\right)=\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(2a\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+a^{2}v+\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}\right). 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=b\cdot\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+bv\right)+\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial y^{2}}+b\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\right)=\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(2b\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+b^{2}v+\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial y^{2}}\right). 
$$
代入已知等式可得，
$$
 \mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left[\left(2a\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+a^{2}v+\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}\right)-2\left(2b\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+b^{2}v+\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial y^{2}}\right)+3\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+av\right)-4\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+bv\right)\right]=0. 
$$
整理上式，可得
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial y^{2}}+(2a+3)\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}-(4b+4)\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+(a^{2}v-2b^{2}v+3a v-4b v)=0. 
$$
要使得式中不含有 $ v(x,y) $ 的一阶偏导数，需使 $ 2a+3=0,4b+4=0 $。解得 $ a=-\frac{3}{2},b=-1 $。
因此，$ a=-\frac{3}{2},b=-1 $。
sourceText: 900 第四章数二 A 类37

contentMarkdown: 设变换 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}u&=x-2y,\\ v&=x+ay\end{aligned}\right. $ 可把方程 $ 6\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}-\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $ 简化为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}=0 $ ，求常数 $ a $ 。（这里应假设 $ z $ 有二阶连续偏导数）
explanationMarkdown:
由变换 $ u = x - 2y $, $ v = x + ay $，计算一阶偏导数：
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial z}{\partial u} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial v}, \quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -2\frac{\partial z}{\partial u} + a\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}. 
$$
计算二阶偏导数：
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}} = \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}} + 2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}, 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = -2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}} + (a-2)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + a\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}, 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}} = 4\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}} - 4a\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + a^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}. 
$$
代入原方程 $ 6\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}-\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $，整理得：
$$
 (10+5a)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + (6+a-a^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}} = 0. 
$$
为使方程简化为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} = 0 $，需满足：
$$
 \begin{cases}10+5a \neq 0, \\ 6+a-a^{2} = 0.\end{cases} 
$$
由 $ 6+a-a^{2} = 0 $ 得 $ (3-a)(2+a) = 0 $，解得 $ a = 3 $ 或 $ a = -2 $。由 $ 10+5a \neq 0 $ 得 $ a \neq -2 $，且若 $ a = -2 $ 则 $ u = v $，变换无意义。因此取 $ a = 3 $。

contentMarkdown:
设函数 $ z(x,y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，则下列各项中的变换能将方程 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}-3\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $ 化简为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}=0 $ 的是（）

A. $ \left\{\begin{aligned}u&=x+y,\\ v&=-\frac{2}{3}x+y.\end{aligned}\right. $
B. $ \left\{\begin{aligned}u&=x-\frac{2}{3}y,\\ v&=x+y.\end{aligned}\right. $
C. $ \left\{\begin{aligned}u&=x-\frac{2}{3}y,\\ v&=\frac{3}{2}x+y.\end{aligned}\right. $
D. $ \left\{\begin{aligned}u&=x+\frac{2}{3}y,\\ v&=-\frac{3}{2}x+y.\end{aligned}\right. $
explanationMarkdown:
观察选项知，可设 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}u&=x+by,\\ v&=cx+y.\end{aligned}\right. $ 将 u, v 看作中间变量，分别计算 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}, \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}, \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}, \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}} $。计算得： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}+c\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}=b\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}+2c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}+c^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+c\frac{\partial z^{2}}{\partial v^{2}}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}=b\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}+\left(1+b c\right)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}+c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}\;=\;b\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}\;\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\;+\;b\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}\;\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\;+\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v\partial u}\;\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\;+\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}\;\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\;=\;b^{2}\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}\;+\;2b\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}\;+\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}. 
$$
 代入原方程 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}-3\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $，可得 
$$
 \left(2+b-3b^{2}\right)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}+\left(4c+1+b c-6b\right)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}+\left(2c^{2}+c-3\right)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}=0. 
$$
 由已知条件，该方程可化简为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}=0 $，故 
$$
 \begin{cases}2+b-3b^{2}=0,\\4c+1+bc-6b\neq0,\\2c^{2}+c-3=0.\end{cases} 
$$
 解得 b = 1 或 $ -\frac{2}{3} $，c = 1 或 $ -\frac{3}{2} $。由此可排除选项 A、C、D。并且，选项 B 满足 $ b = -\frac{2}{3} $，c = 1，且符合 $ 4c + 1 + bc - 6b \neq 0 $ 的要求。因此，应选 B.
