contentMarkdown: 设 $ z = z(x, y) $ 二阶偏导数连续，且 $ \begin{cases} u = x + ay, \\ v = x + by \end{cases} $（$a \lt b$）可将方程 $ 3\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}} - 4\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} + \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}} = 0 $ 化简为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u \partial v} = 0, z(x, 0) = \sin x, z_{y}^{\prime}(x, 0) = 0. $ (1) 求 $a,b$ 的值；(2) 求 $ z(x,y) $ 的表达式.
explanationMarkdown:
由 $u=x+ay$，$v=x+by$ 得 $z_x=z_u+z_v$，$z_y=az_u+bz_v$。代入原方程后，$z_{uu}$ 与 $z_{vv}$ 的系数分别为 $a^2-4a+3$、$b^2-4b+3$。令二者为 $0$，并由 $a\lt b$ 得 $a=1,b=3$，此时方程化为 $z_{uv}=0$。故 $z=f(x+y)+g(x+3y)$。由 $z(x,0)=\sin x$ 得 $f(x)+g(x)=\sin x$；由 $z_y(x,0)=0$ 得 $f'(x)+3g'(x)=0$。再由 $f'(x)+g'(x)=\cos x$，解得 $f'(x)=\frac{3}{2}\cos x$，$g'(x)=-\frac{1}{2}\cos x$。积分并结合 $f(x)+g(x)=\sin x$，得 
$$
z=\frac{3}{2}\sin(x+y)-\frac{1}{2}\sin(x+3y).
$$

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ u = f(x, y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，作变量代换 $ \xi = x, \eta = y - x $，将方程 $ \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} + 2\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x \partial y} + \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2} = 0 $ 化为以 $ \xi, \eta $ 为自变量的方程。
explanationMarkdown:
由题，函数复合关系如图所示，所以 
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta},\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}, 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}&=\frac{\partial}{\partial\xi}\big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\big)\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial}{\partial\eta}\big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\big)\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}\\&=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}-\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\\&=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}&=\frac{\partial}{\partial\xi}\Big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\Big)\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial}{\partial\eta}\Big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\Big)\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}\\&=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}-\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}. 
$$
 故 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}=0, 
$$
 即 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}=0. 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ u = f(x, y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且满足等式 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}} + 3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y} + \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}} = 0 $。确定 a, b 的值，使等式在变换 $ \xi = x + ay, \eta = bx + 2y (ab \neq 2) $ 下简化为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} = 0 $。
explanationMarkdown:
由 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}\xi&=x+ay,\\ \eta&=bx+2y\end{aligned}\right. $ 可得 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}x&=\frac{a\eta-2\xi}{ab-2},\\ y&=\frac{b\xi-\eta}{ab-2}.\end{aligned}\right. $ 注意到 $ u=f(x,y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数。由链式法则， $ u=f(x(\xi,\eta),y(\xi,\eta)) $ 仍具有关于 $ \xi,\eta $ 的二阶连续偏导数，从而 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi} $。由链式法则可得， 
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+b\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}=a\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+2\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}, 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}&=\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+b\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\right)}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}\\&=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+2b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+b^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}&=\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+b\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\right)}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}\\&=a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+\left(ab+2\right)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+2b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}&=\frac{\partial\left(a\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+2\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\right)}{\partial y}=a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}\\&=a^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+4a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+4\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}.\end{aligned} 
$$
 代入 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $ ，整理得 
$$
 \left(a^{2}+3a+2\right)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+\left(2b^{2}+6b+4\right)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}+\left[3\left(a b+2\right)+4a+4b\right]\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=0. 
$$
 由上式等价于 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=0 $可得， 
$$
 \begin{cases}a^{2}+3a+2=0,\\2b^{2}+6b+4=0,\\3\left(ab+2\right)+4a+4b\neq0.\end{cases} 
$$
 由前两个方程解得 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-1,\\ b&=-1,\end{aligned}\right. $或 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-2,\\ b&=-2\end{aligned}\right. $（舍去ab=2的解）。 将这两组解代入 $ 3(ab+2)+4a+4b $均不为零，故这两组解均符合要求。
sourceText: 900 第四章数二 A 类 38

contentMarkdown: 设 $u(x,y)$ 有二阶连续偏导数，利用变换 $\xi=x+ay,\eta=x+by$，将方程 $\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+4\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}+3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=0$ 化为 $\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=0$，求 $a,b$ 的值。
explanationMarkdown: 视 $\xi$、$\eta$ 为中间变量，$x$、$y$ 为自变量。由已知，得 $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\cdot1+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\cdot1$，$\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\cdot a+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\cdot b$。这里 $\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}$、$\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}$ 是以 $\xi$、$\eta$ 为中间变量，$x$、$y$ 为自变量的二元函数，故 $\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}$，$\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=a^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+2ab\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+b^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}$，$\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}=a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+(a+b)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}$。代入已知方程，得 $\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+4\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}+3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=(1+4a+3a^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+\left[2+4(a+b)+6ab\right]\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+(1+4b+3b^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}$。又由已知，得 $\begin{cases}1+4a+3a^{2}=0,\\1+4b+3b^{2}=0,\\2+4(a+b)+6ab\neq0,\end{cases}$ 联立①、②式解得 $\left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-1,\\ b&=-\frac{1}{3}\end{aligned}\right.$ 或 $\left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-\frac{1}{3},\\ b&=-1,\end{aligned}\right.$ 且都满足③式，故为所求。

由题设知 $ y = y(x) $ 与 $ z = z(x) $ 是由方程组
$$
 \left\{\begin{aligned}z&=x^{2}+2y^{2}\\ x^{2}-xy+y^{2}&=1\end{aligned}\right. 
$$
 
确定的两个隐函数，将方程组中每个方程看成关于 x 的恒等式并对 x 求导数，得
$$
 \left\{\begin{aligned}z^{\prime}&=2x+4y y^{\prime}\\ 2x-y-x y^{\prime}+2y y^{\prime}&=0\end{aligned}\right. 
$$
 
用 x = 1, $ y(1) = 1 $ 代入可得
$$
 \left\{\begin{aligned}z^{\prime}(1)&=2+4y^{\prime}(1)\\ 2-1-y^{\prime}(1)+2y^{\prime}(1)&=0\end{aligned}\right.\Rightarrow\left\{\begin{aligned}y^{\prime}(1)&=-1\\ z^{\prime}(1)&=-2\end{aligned}\right. 
$$
 
将方程组中每个方程看成关于x的恒等式，对x求导数，得
$$
 \left\{\begin{aligned}z^{\prime \prime}&=2+4(y^{\prime})^{2}+4y y^{\prime \prime}\\ 2-y^{\prime}-y^{\prime}-x y^{\prime \prime}+2(y^{\prime})^{2}+2y y^{\prime \prime}=0\end{aligned}\right. 
$$
 
用 x = 1, $ y(1) = 1 $ 和 $ y'(1) = -1 $ 代入上面所得的方程组即得
$$
 \left\{\begin{aligned}z^{\prime \prime}(1)&=2+4+4y^{\prime \prime}(1)\\ 2+2-y^{\prime \prime}(1)&+2+2y^{\prime \prime}(1)\end{aligned}\right.\Rightarrow\left\{\begin{aligned}y^{\prime \prime}(1)&=-6\\ z^{\prime \prime}(1)&=-18\end{aligned}\right. 
$$
 
故应选(D).

contentMarkdown: 已知函数 $ f(u) $ 具有二阶导数，且 $ f'(1) = 1 $，函数 $ y = y(x) $ 由方程 $ \ln y - xe^{y} = 1 - \cos x $ 所确定。设 $ z = f(y - \arctan ex) $，求 $ \left. \frac{dz}{dx} \right|_{x=0}, \left. \frac{d^{2}z}{dx^{2}} \right|_{x=0} $。
explanationMarkdown:
由链式法则,我们有
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}=f^{\prime}(y-\arctan\mathrm{e}x)\left(y^{\prime}-\frac{\mathrm{e}}{1+\mathrm{e}^{2}x^{2}}\right), 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}z}{\mathrm{d}x^{2}}=\frac{\mathrm{d}\left(\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}\right)}{\mathrm{d}x}=f^{\prime \prime}(y-\arctan\mathrm{e}x)\left(y^{\prime}-\frac{\mathrm{e}}{1+\mathrm{e}^{2}x^{2}}\right)^{2}+f^{\prime}(y-\arctan\mathrm{e}x)\left[y^{\prime \prime}+\frac{2\mathrm{e}^{3}x}{\left(1+\mathrm{e}^{2}x^{2}\right)^{2}}\right]. 
$$
 
由上可知，要求得 $ \left.\frac{dz}{dx}\right|_{x=0} $以及 $ \left.\frac{d^{2}z}{dx^{2}}\right|_{x=0} $，需要知道 $ y,y',y'' $在x=0处的值.
由 $ \ln y - xe^{y} = 1 - \cos x $ 知， $ y(0) = 1 $.
下面计算 $ y'(0) $, $ y''(0) $.
对等式 $ \ln y - xe^{y} = 1 - \cos x $ 两端关于 x 求导，得
$$
 \frac{y^{\prime}}{y}-\mathrm{e}^{y}-x\mathrm{e}^{y}y^{\prime}=\sin x. 
$$
 
代入 $ y(0) = 1 $，得 $ y'(0) = e $.
对(1)式两端再次关于x求导,得
$$
 \frac{y^{\prime \prime}y-\left(y^{\prime}\right)^{2}}{y^{2}}-\mathrm{e}^{y}y^{\prime}-\mathrm{e}^{y}y^{\prime}-x\mathrm{e}^{y}\left(y^{\prime}\right)^{2}-x\mathrm{e}^{y}y^{\prime \prime}=\cos x. 
$$
 
代入 $ y(0)=1, y'(0)=\mathrm{e} $，得 $ y''(0)=1+3\mathrm{e}^{2} $
将 $ y(0) = 1, y'(0) = e, y''(0) = 1 + 3e^{2} $ 以及 $ f'(1) = 1 $ 代回 $ \frac{dz}{dx} $ 和 $ \frac{d^{2}z}{dx^{2}} $ 的表达式，得
$$
 \left.\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}\right|_{x=0}=f^{\prime}(1)(e-e)=0, 
$$
 
$$
 \left.\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}z}{\mathrm{d}x^{2}}\right|_{x=0}=f^{\prime \prime}(1)\left(\mathrm{e}-\mathrm{e}\right)^{2}+f^{\prime}(1)\left(1+3\mathrm{e}^{2}+0\right)=1+3\mathrm{e}^{2}. 
$$
sourceText: 900 第四章数二 B 类 24

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ f(u, v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数， $ y = y(x) $ 由方程 $ \tan y - y = x $ 所确定，令 $ z(x) = f(x, x - y) $，计算 $ \left. \frac{d^2 z}{dx^2} \right|_{x=1-\frac{\pi}{4}} $。
explanationMarkdown:
计算 $ \frac{dz}{dx},\frac{d^{2}z}{dx^{2}} $。
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}=f_{1}^{\prime}+f_{2}^{\prime}\left(1-\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right), 
$$
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}z}{\mathrm{d}x^{2}}&=f_{11}^{\prime \prime}+f_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(1-\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right)+f_{21}^{\prime \prime}\left(1-\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right)+f_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(1-\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right)^{2}-f_{2}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}y}{\mathrm{d}x^{2}}\\&=f_{11}^{\prime \prime}+2f_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(1-\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right)+f_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(1-\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right)^{2}-f_{2}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}y}{\mathrm{d}x^{2}}.\end{aligned} 
$$
令 $ F(y) = \tan y - y $，计算可得
$$
 F^{\prime}(y)=\sec^{2}y-1=\tan^{2}y\geqslant0. 
$$
于是， $ F(y) $ 单调增加。由于 $ F\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)=1-\frac{\pi}{4} $，故当 $ x=1-\frac{\pi}{4} $ 时， $ y=\frac{\pi}{4} $。
下面计算 $ \frac{dy}{dx},\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}} $。对方程 $ \tan y - y = x $ 两端同时关于 x 求导，得 $ \sec^{2}y \cdot \frac{dy}{dx} - \frac{dy}{dx} = 1 $，即 $ \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{\sec^{2}y - 1} = \frac{1}{\tan^{2}y} $。
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}y}{\mathrm{d}x^{2}}=\frac{-2\tan y\sec^{2}y}{\tan^{4}y}\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{-2\sec^{2}y}{\tan^{3}y}\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}. 
$$
代入 $ x = 1 - \frac{\pi}{4}, y = \frac{\pi}{4} $ 知， $ \left.\frac{dy}{dx}\right|_{x=1-\frac{\pi}{4}} = 1, \left.\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}\right|_{x=1-\frac{\pi}{4}} = -4 $。
因此， $ \left.\frac{d^{2}z}{dx^{2}}\right|_{x=1-\frac{\pi}{4}}=f_{11}^{\prime\prime}\left(1-\frac{\pi}{4},1-\frac{\pi}{2}\right)+4f_{2}^{\prime}\left(1-\frac{\pi}{4},1-\frac{\pi}{2}\right) $。
sourceText: 900 第四章数二 A 类 35

contentMarkdown: 设 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程组 $ \left\{\begin{aligned} x &= (t + 1) \cos z, \\ y &= t \sin z \end{aligned}\right. $ 确定，则 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = $ ___.
explanationMarkdown:
将 $ x, y $ 视为自变量，$ z, t $ 视为隐函数，方程组两边对 $ x $ 求偏导数，有
$$
 \left\{\begin{aligned} \cos z \cdot \frac{\partial t}{\partial x} - (t+1)\sin z \cdot \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} &= 1, \\ \sin z \cdot \frac{\partial t}{\partial x} + t\cos z \cdot \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} &= 0. \end{aligned}\right. 
$$
①式乘以 $ \sin z $ 减去②式乘以 $ \cos z $ 得
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{-\sin z}{(1+t)\sin^{2}z + t\cos^{2}z} = \frac{-\tan^{2}z}{y + x\tan^{3}z}. 
$$
sourceText: 1994 年江苏省高等数学竞赛题

contentMarkdown:
设方程组 $ \left\{\begin{aligned} x &= u + vz, \\ y &= -u^{2} + v + z \end{aligned}\right. $ 在点 $ (2,1,1) $ 的某一个邻域内确定隐函数 $ u(x,y,z) $ 与 $ v(x,y,z) $，且 $ u(2,1,1) \gt 0 $，则 $ \left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial v}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial u}{\partial z}\right)\bigg|_{(2,1,1)} = $

A. $ \frac{1}{9}. $
B. $ \frac{1}{3}. $
C. $ \frac{2}{9}. $
D. $ \frac{2}{3}. $
explanationMarkdown:
将方程组中每个方程两端求全微分，得
$$
 \left\{\begin{aligned}\mathrm{d}x&=\mathrm{d}u+z\mathrm{d}v+v\mathrm{d}z,\\ \mathrm{d}y&=-2u\mathrm{d}u+\mathrm{d}v+\mathrm{d}z,\end{aligned}\right. 
$$
由此可解出
$$
 \mathrm{d}u=\frac{1}{2u z+1}\big[\mathrm{d}x-z\mathrm{d}y+(z-v)\mathrm{d}z\big], 
$$
$$
 \mathrm{d}v=\frac{1}{2u z+1}\big[2u\mathrm{d}x+\mathrm{d}y-(2u v+1)\mathrm{d}z\big], 
$$
从而
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{1}{2uz+1},\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}=\frac{z-v}{2uz+1},\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}=\frac{1}{2uz+1}. 
$$
在点 $ (2,1,1) $ 处 $ u(2,1,1) $ 与 $ v(2,1,1) $ 满足方程组
$$
 \left\{\begin{aligned}u(2,1,1)+v(2,1,1)&=2,\\ u^{2}(2,1,1)-v(2,1,1)&=0,\end{aligned}\right. 
$$
由此可解得满足 $ u(2,1,1)>0 $ 的函数值分别是 $ u(2,1,1)=v(2,1,1)=1 $，代入即得
$$
 \left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}\right)\Big|_{(2,1,1)}=\frac{z-v+2}{2u z+1}\Big|_{(2,1,1)}=\frac{2}{3}. 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ u = f(x, y, z) $， $ \varphi(x^{2}, \mathrm{e}^{y}, z) = 0 $， $ y = \sin x $，其中 $ f, \varphi $ 都具有一阶连续偏导数，且 $ \frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial z} \neq 0 $，求 $ \frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x} $。
explanationMarkdown:
复合函数求导。
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial z}\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}. 
$$
由 $ y=\sin x $，得 $ \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=\cos x $。
由隐函数 $ \varphi\left(x^{2},\mathrm{~e}^{y},z\right)=0 $ 且 $ \frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial z}\neq0 $，得
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}=-\frac{\varphi_{x}^{\prime}}{\varphi_{z}^{\prime}}=-\frac{\varphi_{1}^{\prime}\cdot2x+\varphi_{2}^{\prime}\cdot\mathrm{e}^{y}\cdot\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}}{\varphi_{3}^{\prime}}=-\frac{1}{\varphi_{3}^{\prime}}\left(2x\varphi_{1}^{\prime}+\mathrm{e}^{y}\cos x\cdot\varphi_{2}^{\prime}\right). 
$$
将 $ \frac{dy}{dx} $， $ \frac{dz}{dx} $ 以及 $ y = \sin x $ 代入 $ \frac{du}{dx} $，得
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\cos x-\frac{\partial f}{\partial z}\cdot\frac{1}{\varphi_{3}^{\prime}}\left(2x\varphi_{1}^{\prime}+\mathrm{e}^{\sin x}\cos x\cdot\varphi_{2}^{\prime}\right). 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $u=f(x,y,z)$ 有连续偏导数，$y=y(x)$ 和 $z=z(x)$ 分别由方程 $e^{xy}-y=0$ 和 $e^{x}-xz=0$ 所确定，求 $\frac{du}{dx}$。
explanationMarkdown:
由全导数公式，
$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=f_x+f_y\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}+f_z\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}.
$$
对 $\mathrm{e}^{xy}-y=0$ 求导，得
$$
\mathrm{e}^{xy}(y+xy')-y'=0.
$$
利用 $\mathrm{e}^{xy}=y$，可得
$$
y'=\frac{y^2}{1-xy}.
$$
对题干中的第二个方程 $\mathrm{e}^x-xz=0$ 求导，得
$$
\mathrm{e}^x-z-xz'=0.
$$
再利用 $\mathrm{e}^x=xz$，得到
$$
z'=\frac{\mathrm{e}^x-z}{x}=\frac{z(x-1)}{x}.
$$
代入全导数公式，即得
$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=f_x+\frac{y^2}{1-xy}f_y+\frac{z(x-1)}{x}f_z.
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ u=f(x,y,z) $ 有连续偏导数， $ y=y(x),z=z(x) $ 分别由方程 $ e^{xy}-y=0 $ 和 $ e^{z}-xz=0 $ 确定，求 $ \frac{du}{dx} $。
explanationMarkdown:
依题设，有
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=f_{1}^{\prime}+f_{2}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}+f_{3}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}. 
$$
方程 $ e^{xy}-y=0 $ 两边同时对 x 求导，得 $ e^{xy}\left(y+x\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right)-\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=0 $，解得
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{y^{2}}{1-xy}. 
$$
方程 $ e^{z}-xz=0 $ 两边同时对 x 求导，得 $ e^{z}\frac{dz}{dx}-z-x\frac{dz}{dx}=0 $，解得
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{z}{xz-x}. 
$$
将以上两式代入，得 $ \frac{du}{dx}=f_{1}^{\prime}+\frac{y^{2}}{1-xy}f_{2}^{\prime}+\frac{z}{xz-x}f_{3}^{\prime} $。

contentMarkdown: 设 $ \begin{cases}y=f(x,t),\\F(x,y,t)=0,\end{cases} $ $ f,F $ 有一阶连续偏导数，则 $ \frac{dy}{dx}= $___
explanationMarkdown:
由已知方程组确定 $ y = y(x) $， $ t = t(x) $，方程两边同时对 $ x $ 求导，得 
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=f_{x}^{\prime}+f_{t}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}t}{\mathrm{d}x},\ F_{x}^{\prime}+F_{y}^{\prime}\bullet\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}+F_{t}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}t}{\mathrm{d}x}=0, 
$$
 两式消去 $ \frac{dt}{dx} $，得 $ \frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{f_{x}^{\prime}F_{t}^{\prime}-f_{t}^{\prime}F_{x}^{\prime}}{F_{t}^{\prime}+f_{t}^{\prime}F_{y}^{\prime}} $。
sourceText: 1998 年江苏省高等数学竞赛题；880 第四章基础填空 7（重点）

contentMarkdown: 设 $ y = y(x) $, $ z = z(x) $ 是由方程 $ z = xf(x + y) $ 和 $ F(x, y, z) = 0 $ 所确定的函数，其中 $ f $ 和 $ F $ 分别具有一阶连续导数和一阶连续偏导数，求 $ \frac{dz}{dx} $。
explanationMarkdown:
对 $ x $ 求导： 
$$
 \frac{d z}{d x}=f(x+y)+x f^{\prime}(x+y)\left(1+\frac{d y}{d x}\right), 
$$
 
$$
 F_{x}^{\prime}+F_{y}^{\prime}\cdot\frac{d y}{d x}+F_{z}^{\prime}\cdot\frac{d z}{d x}=0. 
$$
 联立解得： 
$$
 \frac{d z}{d x}=\frac{(f+x f^{\prime})F_{y}^{\prime}-x f^{\prime}F_{x}^{\prime}}{F_{y}^{\prime}+x f^{\prime}F_{z}^{\prime}}。 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ u = f(x, y, z) $ 有连续的一阶偏导数，又函数 $ y = y(x) $ 及 $ z = z(x) $ 分别由下列两式确定： $ e^{xy}-xy=2 $ 和 $ e^{x}=\int_{0}^{x-z}\frac{\sin t}{t}dt $，求 $ \frac{du}{dx} $。
explanationMarkdown:
第一步：求 $ \frac{dy}{dx} $。由 $ u = f(x, y, z) $ 知 $ \frac{du}{dx}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\frac{dy}{dx}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial z}\frac{dz}{dx} $。 $ e^{xy}-xy=2 $ 两边对 $ x $ 求导得 $ e^{xy}\left(y+x\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right)-\left(y+x\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right)=0 $，化简得 $ (\mathrm{e}^{xy}-1)\left(y+x\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right)=0 $。由于 $ e^{xy}-1 \neq 0 $，故 $ y+x\frac{dy}{dx}=0 $，从而 $ \frac{dy}{dx}=-\frac{y}{x} $。
第二步：求 $ \frac{dz}{dx} $。 $ e^{x}=\int_{0}^{x-z}\frac{\sin t}{t}dt $ 两边对 $ x $ 求导得 $ e^{x}=\frac{\sin(x-z)}{x-z}\cdot\left(1-\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}\right) $，解得 $ \frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}=1-\frac{\mathrm{e}^{x}(x-z)}{\sin(x-z)} $。
第三步：得出结果 $ \frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}-\frac{y}{x}\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}+\left[1-\frac{\mathrm{e}^{x}(x-z)}{\sin(x-z)}\right]\frac{\partial f}{\partial z} $。

contentMarkdown: 设 $ y = y(x) $, $ z = z(x) $ 由方程组 $ \begin{cases} x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2} = 3x, \\ 2x - 3y + 5z = 4 \end{cases} $ 确定，求 $ \frac{dy}{dx} $， $ \frac{dz}{dx} $。
explanationMarkdown:
方程组两边同时对 $ x $ 求导，得 
$$
 \begin{cases}2x+2y\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}+2z\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}=3,\\2-3\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}+5\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}=0,\end{cases} 
$$
 解方程组，得 
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{\left|\begin{array}{cc}3-2x&2z\\ -2&5\end{array}\right|}{\left|\begin{array}{cc}2y&2z\\ -3&5\end{array}\right|}=-\frac{10x-4z-15}{2(5y+3z)}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{\left|\begin{array}{cc}2y&3-2x\\-3&-2\end{array}\right|}{\left|\begin{array}{cc}2y&2z\\-3&5\end{array}\right|}=-\frac{6x+4y-9}{2(5y+3z)}。 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ x = x(y) $, $ z = z(y) $ 由方程组 $ \begin{cases} F(y - x, y - z) = 0, \\ G\left(xy, \frac{z}{y}\right) = 0 \end{cases} $ 确定，求 $ \frac{dx}{dy}, \frac{dz}{dy} $。
explanationMarkdown:
方程组等号两边同时对 $ y $ 求导，得 
$$
 \begin{cases}F_{1}^{\prime}\bullet\left(1-\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}y}\right)+F_{2}^{\prime}\bullet\left(1-\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}y}\right)=0,\\G_{1}^{\prime}\bullet\left(x+y\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}y}\right)+G_{2}^{\prime}\bullet\left(-\frac{z}{y^{2}}+\frac{1}{y}\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}y}\right)=0,\end{cases} 
$$
 整理，得 
$$
 \begin{cases}F_{1}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}y}+F_{2}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}y}=F_{1}^{\prime}+F_{2}^{\prime},\\yG_{1}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}y}+\frac{1}{y}G_{2}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}y}=\frac{z}{y^{2}}G_{2}^{\prime}-xG_{1}^{\prime},\end{cases} 
$$
 解此方程组，得 
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}y}=\frac{\left|\begin{array}{cc}F_{1}^{\prime}+F_{2}^{\prime}&F_{2}^{\prime}\\\frac{z}{y^{2}}G_{2}^{\prime}-xG_{1}^{\prime}&\frac{1}{y}G_{2}^{\prime}\\\end{array}\right|}{\left|\begin{array}{cc}F_{1}^{\prime}&F_{2}^{\prime}\\yG_{1}^{\prime}&\frac{1}{y}G_{2}^{\prime}\\\end{array}\right|}=\frac{\frac{1}{y}F_{1}^{\prime}G_{2}^{\prime}+xF_{2}^{\prime}G_{1}^{\prime}+\left(\frac{1}{y}-\frac{z}{y^{2}}\right)F_{2}^{\prime}G_{2}^{\prime}}{\frac{1}{y}F_{1}^{\prime}G_{2}^{\prime}-yF_{2}^{\prime}G_{1}^{\prime}}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}y}=-\frac{(x+y)F_{1}^{\prime}G_{1}^{\prime}+yF_{2}^{\prime}G_{1}^{\prime}-\frac{z}{y^{2}}F_{1}^{\prime}G_{2}^{\prime}}{\frac{1}{y}F_{1}^{\prime}G_{2}^{\prime}-yF_{2}^{\prime}G_{1}^{\prime}}。 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ y = f(x, t) $，$ t = t(x, y) $ 由方程 $ G(x, y, t) = 0 $ 确定，$ f, G $ 可微，则 $ \frac{dy}{dx} = $ ___
explanationMarkdown: 令 $ F(x, y, t) = f(x, t) - y = 0 $，则 $ \left\{\begin{aligned} F(x, y, t) &= 0, \\ G(x, y, t) &= 0 \end{aligned}\right. $ 确定 $ y = y(x), t = t(x) $。方程组两边同时对 $ x $ 求导，得 $ \begin{cases}F_{x}^{\prime}+F_{y}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}+F_{t}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}t}{\mathrm{d}x}=f_{x}^{\prime}+f_{t}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}t}{\mathrm{d}x}-\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=0,\\G_{x}^{\prime}+G_{y}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}+G_{t}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}t}{\mathrm{d}x}=0,\end{cases} $。解方程组，得 $ \frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{G_{t}^{\prime}f_{x}^{\prime}-G_{x}^{\prime}f_{t}^{\prime}}{G_{y}^{\prime}f_{t}^{\prime}+G_{t}^{\prime}} $。

contentMarkdown: 已知 $ x + y - z = e^{z} $, $ xe^{x} = \tan t $, $ y = \cos t $, 求 $ \left.\frac{d^{2}z}{dt^{2}}\right|_{t=0} $.
explanationMarkdown:
由 $ x\mathrm{e}^{x}=\tan t $ ，可知 $ x $ 是 $ t $ 的函数，同理 $ y=\cos t $ ，$ y $ 也是 $ t $ 的函数，再由 $ x+y-z=\mathrm{e}^{z} $ ，可知 $ z $ 是 $ t $ 的一元函数。方程 $ x + y - z = e^{z} $ 两边同时对 $ t $ 求导，得
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t}+\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t}-\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}t}=\mathrm{e}^{z}\bullet\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}t}, 
$$
故 $ \frac{dz}{dt}=\frac{1}{1+e^{z}}\left(\frac{dx}{dt}+\frac{dy}{dt}\right) $.再求导，得
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}x}{\mathrm{d}t^{2}}+\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}y}{\mathrm{d}t^{2}}-\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}z}{\mathrm{d}t^{2}}&=\mathrm{e}^{z}\Big(\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}t}\Big)^{2}+\mathrm{e}^{z}\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}z}{\mathrm{d}t^{2}},\\\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}z}{\mathrm{d}t^{2}}&=\frac{1}{1+\mathrm{e}^{z}}\Big[\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}x}{\mathrm{d}t^{2}}+\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}y}{\mathrm{d}t^{2}}-\mathrm{e}^{z}\Big(\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}t}\Big)^{2}\Big]\\&=\frac{1}{1+\mathrm{e}^{z}}\Big[\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}x}{\mathrm{d}t^{2}}+\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}y}{\mathrm{d}t^{2}}-\mathrm{e}^{z}\bullet\frac{1}{(1+\mathrm{e}^{z})^{2}}\Big(\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t}+\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t}\Big)^{2}\Big].\end{align*} 
$$
而 $ \frac{dy}{dt}=-\sin t,\quad\frac{d^{2}y}{dt^{2}}=-\cos t, $又由 $ x\mathrm{e}^{x}=\tan t, $得 $ e^{x}\frac{dx}{dt}+xe^{x}\frac{dx}{dt}=\sec^{2}t. $再对 $ t $ 求导，得
$$
 \mathrm{e}^{x}\left(\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t}\right)^{2}+\mathrm{e}^{x}\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}x}{\mathrm{d}t^{2}}+\mathrm{e}^{x}\left(\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t}\right)^{2}+x\mathrm{e}^{x}\left(\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t}\right)^{2}+x\mathrm{e}^{x}\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}x}{\mathrm{d}t^{2}}=2\sec^{2}t\cdot\tan t, 
$$
故
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t}=\frac{\sec^{2}t}{(1+x)\mathrm{e}^{x}}, 
$$
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}x}{\mathrm{d}t^{2}}=\frac{\sec^{2}t\left[2\mathrm{e}^{x}(1+x)^{2}\tan t-(2+x)\sec^{2}t\right]}{(1+x)^{3}\mathrm{e}^{2x}}. 
$$
当 $ t=0 $ 时，由 $ xe^{x}=0 $，得 $ x=0 $，而 $ y=\cos0=1 $。将 $ x=0 $，$ y=1 $ 代入 $ x+y-z=e^{z} $，得 $ z=0 $。
$$
 \left.\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t}\right|_{t=0}=1,\left.\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t}\right|_{t=0}=0,\left.\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}x}{\mathrm{d}t^{2}}\right|_{t=0}=-2,\left.\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}y}{\mathrm{d}t^{2}}\right|_{t=0}=-1, 
$$
代入①式，可知 $ \left.\frac{d^{2}z}{dt^{2}}\right|_{t=0}=-\frac{13}{8}. $

contentMarkdown:
设 $z=z(x,y)$ 由方程组 $\begin{cases} x=ue^v,\\ y=uv,\\ z=v, \end{cases}(u\gt0,v\gt1)$ 所确定，则 $\dfrac{\partial^2 z}{\partial x\partial y}= $（ ）。

A. $ \frac{xy}{z(1-z)^{3}} $
B. $ \frac{xy}{z(z-1)^{3}} $
C. $ \frac{z}{xy(1-z)^{3}} $
D. $ \frac{z}{xy(z-1)^{3}} $
explanationMarkdown:
由 $z=v$，$x=ue^v$，$y=uv$ 得 $u=xe^{-z}$，从而 
$$
\frac{y}{x}=ze^{-z}.
$$
 设 $g(z)=ze^{-z}$，则 $g^\prime(z)=e^{-z}(1-z)$。对 $x,y$ 分别求偏导得 
$$
z_x=\frac{z}{x(z-1)},\qquad z_y=-\frac{z}{y(z-1)}.
$$
 因而 
$$
z_{xy}=\frac{\partial}{\partial x}left(-\frac{z}{y(z-1)})=\frac{z_x}{y(z-1)^2}=\frac{z}{xy(z-1)^3}.
$$
 故选 D。

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ f(u) $ 可微，且 $ f'(0)=\frac{1}{2} $，则 $ z=f\left(4x^{2}-y^{2}\right) $ 在点（1,2）处的全微分 $ dz\Big|_{(1,2)}= $ ___
explanationMarkdown:
记 $ u = 4x^2 - y^2 $，则 $ z = f(u) $， $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = f'(u) \cdot u_x' = f'(u) \cdot 8x $， $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = f'(u) \cdot u_y' = f'(u) \cdot (-2y) $。全微分为 
$$
 \mathrm{d}z=\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\mathrm{d}x+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\mathrm{d}y = f^{\prime}(u)\cdot8x\mathrm{d}x+f^{\prime}(u)\cdot(-2y)\mathrm{d}y. 
$$
 代入 x=1, y=2，可得 $ f^{\prime}(u)=\left.f^{\prime}\left(4x^{2}-y^{2}\right)\right|_{(1,2)} = f^{\prime}(0)=\frac{1}{2} $。所以 $ dz=\left(8\cdot\frac{1}{2}\right)dx-\left(\frac{1}{2}\cdot2\cdot2\right)dy =4dx-2dy. $

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ f(u,v) $ 可微， $ z=z(x,y) $ 由方程 $ (x+1)z-y^{2}=x^{2}f(x-z,y) $ 确定，则 $ \left.\mathrm{d}z\right|_{(0,1)}= $ ___
explanationMarkdown:
（法一）对已知方程两端分别关于 x, y 求偏导数，可得 
$$
 z+\left(x+1\right)\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=2x f(x-z,y)+x^{2}\left[f_{1}^{\prime}(x-z,y)\cdot\left(1-\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)\right]. 
$$
 
$$
 \left(x+1\right)\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}-2y=x^{2}\left[f_{1}^{\prime}(x-z,y)\cdot\left(-\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)+f_{2}^{\prime}(x-z,y)\right]. 
$$
 将 $ (x,y)=(0,1) $代入已知方程，可得z-1=0，从而 $ z(0,1)=1 $。再将 $ (x,y,z)=(0,1,1) $代入上两式，可得 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,1)}=-1,\left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{(0,1)}=2 $。因此， 
$$
 \mathrm{d}z\mid_{(0,1)}=-\mathrm{d}x+2\mathrm{d}y. 
$$
 （法二）对已知方程两端微分，可得 $ \mathrm{d}\left[\left(x+1\right)z\right]-\mathrm{d}\left(y^{2}\right)=\mathrm{d}\left[x^{2}f(x-z,y)\right] $. 进一步可得， 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\left(x+1\right)\mathrm{d}z+z\mathrm{d}x-2y\mathrm{d}y&=f(x-z,\ y)\mathrm{d}(x^{2})+x^{2}\mathrm{d}\left[f(x-z,\ y)\right]\\&=2xf(x-z,\ y)\mathrm{d}x+x^{2}\mathrm{d}\left[ f(x-z,\ y)\right].\end{aligned} 
$$
 将 $ (x,y)=(0,1) $代入已知方程，可得z-1=0，从而 $ z(0,1)=1 $。代入上式可得 
$$
 \mathrm{d}z+\mathrm{d}x-2\mathrm{d}y=0, 
$$
 即 $ \mathrm{d}z\mid_{(0,1)}=-\mathrm{d}x+2\mathrm{d}y. $
sourceText: 2016数一三；25 版 660 数一二三

contentMarkdown:
设函数 $f(x,y)$ 可微，且

$$f(x+1,\mathrm{e}^x)=x(x+1)^2$$

$$f(x,x^2)=2x^2\ln x$$

则 $\mathrm{d}f(1,1)$ 等于（ ）。

A. $\mathrm{d}x+\mathrm{d}y$
B. $\mathrm{d}x-\mathrm{d}y$
C. $\mathrm{d}y$
D. $-\mathrm{d}y$
explanationMarkdown: 对第一个等式关于 $x$ 求导，并令 $x=0$，得到$$f_x(1,1)+f_y(1,1)=1$$对第二个等式关于 $x$ 求导，并令 $x=1$，得到$$f_x(1,1)+2f_y(1,1)=2$$联立可得$$f_x(1,1)=0,\; f_y(1,1)=1$$因此$$\mathrm{d}f(1,1)=f_x(1,1)\,\mathrm{d}x+f_y(1,1)\,\mathrm{d}y=\mathrm{d}y$$故选 C。

contentMarkdown:
设 $ f(x,y) $ 有一阶连续偏导数，且 $ f(x,y)=1-x-y+o\left(\sqrt{(x-1)^{2}+y^{2}}\right) $， $ g(x,y)=f(x+y,xy) $，则全微分 $ \mathrm{d}g\big|_{(1,0)}= $（）.

A. -2dy
B. -dx
C. -dx - 2dy
D. dx - 2dy
explanationMarkdown:
依题设，知 
$$
 \lim_{x\to1\atop y\to0}f(x,y)=\lim_{x\to1\atop y\to0}\left[1-x-y+o\left(\sqrt{(x-1)^{2}+y^{2}}\right)\right]=0, 
$$
 故 $ f(1,0)=0. $ 由 
$$
 \begin{aligned} f(x,y)-f(1,0)&=1-x-y+o\left(\sqrt{(x-1)^{2}+y^{2}}\right)\\&=-(x-1)+(-1)y+o\left(\sqrt{(x-1)^{2}+y^{2}}\right),\end{aligned} 
$$
 知 $ f_{x}^{\prime}(1,0)=-1,\ f_{y}^{\prime}(1,0)=-1. $ 又由 
$$
 \begin{aligned}&g_{x}^{\prime}(x,y)=f_{1}^{\prime}(x+y,xy)\cdot1+f_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,xy)\cdot y,\\&g_{y}^{\prime}(x,y)=f_{1}^{\prime}(x+y,xy)\cdot1+f_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,xy)\cdot x,\end{aligned} 
$$
 知 $ g_{x}^{\prime}(1,0)=f_{1}^{\prime}(1,0)=-1,\quad g_{y}^{\prime}(1,0)=f_{1}^{\prime}(1,0)+f_{2}^{\prime}(1,0)=-2. $ 故 $ \mathrm{d}g\mid_{(1,0)}=-\mathrm{d}x-2\mathrm{d}y $ 。选项 C 正确。

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ z = f(x, y) $ ( $ xy \neq 0 $) 满足 $ f(xy, \frac{y}{x}) = y^2(x^2 - 1) $，则 $ dz = $ ___.
explanationMarkdown:
设 $ xy = u, \frac{y}{x} = v $，有 $ x^{2} = \frac{u}{v}, y^{2} = uv $，则
$$
 f(u,v)=uv\left(\frac{u}{v}-1\right)=u^{2}-uv, 
$$
即
$$
 f(x,y)=x^{2}-xy, 
$$
所以
$$
 \mathrm{d}z=(2x-y)\mathrm{d}x-x\mathrm{d}y. 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ f(x,y) $ 具有一阶连续偏导数，且 $ \mathrm{d}f(x,y)=ye^{y}\mathrm{d}x+x(1+y)e^{y}\mathrm{d}y $， $ f(0,0)=0 $，则 $ f(x,y)= $
explanationMarkdown:
本题主要考查求全微分的原函数。题目条件给出了 $ f(x,y) $ 的全微分，从而我们知道 $ f_{x}^{\prime} $ 与 $ f_{y}^{\prime} $，可以通过积分以及初始条件来确定 $ f(x,y) $。
解：由于 $ \mathrm{d}f(x,y)=y\mathrm{e}^{y}\mathrm{d}x+x(1+y)\mathrm{e}^{y}\mathrm{d}y $，故 $ f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y)=ye^{y} $， $ f_{y}^{\prime}(x,y)=x(1+y)e^{y} $。对 $ f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y) $关于x积分，得 $ f(x,y)=\int f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y)\mathrm{d}x=\int y\mathrm{e}^{y}\mathrm{d}x=xy\mathrm{e}^{y}+\varphi(y) $，其中 $ \varphi(y) $ 为关于 y 的一元函数。对 $ xye^{y} + \varphi(y) $ 关于 y 求偏导数，得 $ \frac{\partial\left[x y\mathrm{e}^{y}+\varphi\left(y\right)\right]}{\partial y}=x\mathrm{e}^{y}+x y\mathrm{e}^{y}+\varphi^{\prime}(y)=x(1+y)\mathrm{e}^{y}+\varphi^{\prime}(y) $。与 $ f_{y}^{\prime}(x,y) $比较，得 $ \varphi^{\prime}(y)=0 $，故 $ \varphi(y)\equiv C $，其中C为常数。代入 x=0, y=0，得 $ f(0,0)=0+C $。于是，C=0。因此， $ f(x,y)=xye^{y} $。
注：本题也可以利用凑微分法求解。由于 $ (1+y)e^{y}dy=d(ye^{y}) $，故 $ \mathrm{d}f(x,y)=y\mathrm{e}^{y}\mathrm{d}x+x\mathrm{d}(y\mathrm{e}^{y})=\mathrm{d}(xy\mathrm{e}^{y}) $。设 $ f(x,y)=xy\mathrm{e}^{y}+C $。由 $ f(0,0)=0 $ 可得 C=0。因此， $ f(x,y)=xy\mathrm{e}^{y} $。

contentMarkdown: 已知函数 $ f(x, y) $ 满足 $ \mathrm{d}f(x, y) = \frac{x \mathrm{d}y - y \mathrm{d}x}{x^{2} + y^{2}} $， $ f(1, 1) = \frac{\pi}{4} $，则 $ f(\sqrt{3}, 3) = $ ___
explanationMarkdown: 由 $ \mathrm{d}f = \frac{x}{x^{2}+y^{2}}d y-\frac{y}{x^{2}+y^{2}}d x $，可得 $ \frac{\partial f}{\partial x} = -\frac{y}{x^{2}+y^{2}} $。对 $ \frac{\partial f}{\partial x} $ 关于 x 积分，得 $ f(x,y)=\int\frac{-y}{x^{2}+y^{2}}d x=-\arctan\frac{x}{y}+C(y) $。对 $ f $ 关于 y 求偏导，得 $ \frac{\partial f}{\partial y}=-\frac{-\frac{x}{y^{2}}}{1+(\frac{x}{y})^{2}}+c^{\prime}(y)=\frac{x}{x^{2}+y^{2}}+c^{\prime}(y) $。与 $ \frac{\partial f}{\partial y} = \frac{x}{x^{2}+y^{2}} $ 比较，得 $ c^{\prime}(y)=0 $，故 $ c(y)=c $。因此 $ f(x,y)=-\arctan\frac{x}{y}+c $。代入 $ f(1,1)=\frac{\pi}{4} $，得 $ c=\frac{\pi}{2} $。所以 $ f(x,y)=\frac{\pi}{2}-\arctan\frac{x}{y} $。代入 $ x=\sqrt{3}, y=3 $，得 $ f(\sqrt{3},3)=\frac{\pi}{2}-\arctan\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}=\frac{\pi}{2}-\frac{\pi}{6}=\frac{\pi}{3} $。

contentMarkdown: 设 $ z(x,y) $ 的全微分 $ \mathrm{d}z=\left(x^{2}+2xy-y^{2}\right)\mathrm{d}x+\left(x^{2}-2xy-y^{2}\right)\mathrm{d}y $，则 $ z(x,y)= $ ___
explanationMarkdown: 由已知可得 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=x^{2}+2xy-y^{2} $， $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=x^{2}-2xy-y^{2} $。对 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} $ 关于 x 积分，得 $ z=\int(x^{2}+2xy-y^{2})\mathrm{d}x+\varphi(y)=\frac{1}{3}x^{3}+x^{2}y-xy^{2}+\varphi(y) $。对 $ z $ 关于 y 求偏导，得 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=x^{2}-2xy+\varphi^{\prime}(y) $。与 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=x^{2}-2xy-y^{2} $ 比较，得 $ \varphi^{\prime}(y)=-y^{2} $，积分得 $ \varphi\left(y\right)=-\frac{1}{3}y^{3}+C $（C 为任意常数）。故 $ z(x,y)=\frac{1}{3}x^{3}+x^{2}y-xy^{2}-\frac{1}{3}y^{3}+C $。

【分析】 方法 1：由题设知 $ \frac{\partial f}{\partial x}=2y^{2}+2xy+3x^{2} $， $ \frac{\partial f}{\partial y}=4xy+x^{2} $。由 $ \frac{\partial f}{\partial x}=2y^{2}+2xy+3x^{2} $ 知 $ f(x,y)=\int(2y^{2}+2xy+3x^{2})\mathrm{d}x=2xy^{2}+x^{2}y+x^{3}+\varphi(y) $。由 $ \frac{\partial f}{\partial y}=4xy+x^{2} $ 知， $ 4xy+x^{2}=4xy+x^{2}+\varphi^{\prime}(y) $，所以 $ \varphi^{\prime}(y)=0 $， $ \varphi(y)=C $。则 $ f(x,y)=2xy^{2}+x^{2}y+x^{3}+C $。
方法2： $ \mathrm{d}f(x,y)=(2y^{2}+2xy+3x^{2})\mathrm{d}x+(4xy+x^{2})\mathrm{d}y = (2y^{2}\mathrm{d}x+4xy\mathrm{d}y)+(2xy\mathrm{d}x+x^{2}\mathrm{d}y)+3x^{2}\mathrm{d}x = \mathrm{d}(2xy^{2})+\mathrm{d}(x^{2}y)+\mathrm{d}x^{3} = \mathrm{d}(2xy^{2}+x^{2}y+x^{3}) $。则 $ f(x,y)=2xy^{2}+x^{2}y+x^{3}+C $。
【评注】方法1是利用偏积分，方法2是利用凑微分。这两种方法是已知某个函数的全微分或两个一阶偏导数求原函数的两种常用方法。

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ f(x, y) $ 具有一阶连续偏导数，且 $ \mathrm{d}[f(x, y)] = [\cos(x - y) - \sin(x - y)] \mathrm{e}^{y - x} ( \mathrm{d}x - \mathrm{d}y ) $， $ f(0, 0) = 0 $，则 $ f(x, y) = $ ___
explanationMarkdown: 由于 $ \mathrm{d}\left[f(x,y)\right]=\left[\cos(x-y)-\sin(x-y)\right]\mathrm{e}^{y-x}(\mathrm{d}x-\mathrm{d}y) $，故 $ f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y)=-f_{y}^{\prime}(x,y)=\left[\cos(x-y)-\sin(x-y)\right]\mathrm{e}^{y-x} $。对 $ f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y) $关于x积分，得 $ f(x,y)=\int f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y)\mathrm{d}x=\int\left[\cos(x-y)-\sin(x-y)\right]\mathrm{e}^{y-x}\mathrm{d}x = \int\mathrm{e}^{y-x}\mathrm{d}\left[\sin(x-y)\right]-\int\sin(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{y-x}\mathrm{d}x = \sin(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{y-x}-\int\sin(x-y)\mathrm{d}\left(\mathrm{e}^{y-x}\right)-\int\sin(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{y-x}\mathrm{d}x = \sin(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{y-x}+\int\sin(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{y-x}\mathrm{d}x-\int\sin(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{y-x}\mathrm{d}x = \sin(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{y-x}+\varphi(y) $，其中 $ \varphi(y) $ 为关于 y 的一元函数。对 $ \sin(x-y)e^{y-x}+\varphi(y) $ 关于 y 求偏导数，得 $ \frac{\partial\left[\sin(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{y-x}+\varphi(y)\right]}{\partial y}=-\cos(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{y-x}+\sin(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{y-x}+\varphi^{\prime}(y) = -\left[\cos(x-y)-\sin(x-y)\right]\mathrm{e}^{y-x}+\varphi^{\prime}(y) $。与 $ f_{y}^{\prime}(x,y) $比较，得 $ \varphi^{\prime}(y)=0 $，故 $ \varphi(y)=C $，其中C为常数。代入 x = 0, y = 0，得 $ f(0,0) = 0 + C $。于是，C = 0。因此， $ f(x,y)=\sin(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{y-x} $。
sourceText: 900 第四章数二 A 类 27

contentMarkdown:
设 $ Q(x,y)=\frac{x}{y^{2}},\ y\gt0 $， $ P(x,y)\mathrm{d}x+Q(x,y)\mathrm{d}y $ 是某二元函数的全微分，则 $ P(x,y) $ 可取为（）

A. $ y^{2}-\frac{x^{2}}{y^{3}} $
B. $ x^{2}-\frac{1}{y} $
C. $ \frac{1}{y^{2}}-\frac{x^{2}}{y^{3}} $
D. $ \frac{1}{x^{2}}-\frac{1}{y} $
explanationMarkdown:
设该二元函数为 $ z = z(x, y) $，由题意知， $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{x}{y^{2}} $，可得 $ z(x, y) = -\frac{x}{y} + \varphi(x) $，此时有 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{1}{y}+\varphi^{\prime}(x)=P(x,y) $。观察选项可知，只有选项(B) $ x^{2}-\frac{1}{y} $ 符合 $ P(x,y) = -\frac{1}{y} + \varphi^{\prime}(x) $ 的形式（其中 $ \varphi^{\prime}(x) = x^{2} $）。
【注】(D)项不能选，因为 $ \frac{1}{x^{2}}-\frac{1}{y} $在 $ (0,y) $处无定义。

contentMarkdown: 设 $ \frac{(x+ky)dx+ydy}{(x+y)^2} $ 为某二元函数 $ u(x,y) $ 的全微分，则 $ k = $ ___
explanationMarkdown: 令 $ P=\frac{x+ky}{(x+y)^{2}} $， $ Q=\frac{y}{(x+y)^{2}} $，依题意有 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=P,\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=Q,\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}=\frac{\partial P}{\partial y},\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y\partial x}=\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} $，故 $ \frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial P}{\partial y} $，则有 $ \frac{0-y\cdot2(x+y)}{(x+y)^{4}}=\frac{k(x+y)^{2}-(x+ky)\cdot2(x+y)}{(x+y)^{4}} $，比较两边分子，得 $ -2y=(k-2)x-ky $，解得 $ k=2 $。

A. 1

explanationMarkdown: 记 $ P=\frac{x}{x^{2}+y^{2}-1} $， $ Q=\frac{ay}{x^{2}+y^{2}-1} $，由题意知， $ \frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial P}{\partial y} $，则 $ \frac{2axy}{(x^{2}+y^{2}-1)^{2}}=\frac{2xy}{(x^{2}+y^{2}-1)^{2}} $，故 $ a=1 $。

设二元函数 $ U(x,y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且 $ \mathrm{d}U = P(x,y)\mathrm{d}x + Q(x,y)\mathrm{d}y $，则 $ \frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial P}{\partial y} $ 等于

A. 2
B. 1
C. 0

explanationMarkdown: 因为 $ \mathrm{d}U = P(x, y) \mathrm{d}x + Q(x, y) \mathrm{d}y $，于是 $ \frac{\partial U}{\partial x} = P(x, y) $， $ \frac{\partial U}{\partial y} = Q(x, y) $。 $ \frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial^{2}U}{\partial x\partial y},\quad\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial^{2}U}{\partial y\partial x} $。又因 $ U(x,y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，故 $ \frac{\partial^{2}U}{\partial x\partial y} $ 与 $ \frac{\partial^{2}U}{\partial y\partial x} $ 连续，从而它们相等，即 $ \frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial^{2}U}{\partial y\partial x}-\frac{\partial^{2}U}{\partial x\partial y}=0 $。故应选(C)。

explanationMarkdown:
由 $ f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y)=1+2\cos x $ 知， 
$$
 f(x,y)=x+2\sin x+g(y). 
$$
 由 $ f(x,\sin x)=x+\sin x $ , 得 $ g(\sin x)=-\sin x $ , 即 $ g(y)=-y $ , 故 $ f(x,y)=x+2\sin x-y $ 则 $ f_{y}^{\prime}(x,y)\big|_{y=\sin x}=-1\big|_{y=\sin x}=-1. $

explanationMarkdown: 由 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} = x + y $，对 $ y $ 积分得 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = xy + \frac{1}{2}y^{2} + C(x) $。由 $ f(x, 0) = x $ 得 $ C(x) = 1 $，所以 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = xy + \frac{1}{2}y^{2} + 1 $。再对 $ x $ 积分得 $ z = \frac{1}{2}x^{2}y + \frac{1}{2}xy^{2} + x + D(y) $。由 $ f(0, y) = y^{2} $ 得 $ D(y) = y^{2} $。因此， $ f(x,y)=\frac{1}{2}x^{2}y+\frac{1}{2}x y^{2}+x+y^{2} $。

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ z(x,y) $ 满足 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = \mathrm{e}^{x} + 2y $，且 $ z(x,0) = x $， $ z(0,y) = 2y $，则 $ z(x,y) = $ ___.
explanationMarkdown: 由 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=e^{x}+2y $可得， $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\int\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\mathrm{d}y=\int\left(\mathrm{e}^{x}+2y\right)\mathrm{d}y=y\mathrm{e}^{x}+y^{2}+\varphi\left(x\right) $，其中 $ \varphi(x) $ 是关于 x 的一元函数。对 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} $关于x积分可得， $ z(x,y)\;=\;\int\left[y\mathrm{e}^{x}+y^{2}\;+\;\varphi(x)\;\right]\mathrm{d}x\;=\;y\mathrm{e}^{x}+x y^{2}\;+\;\varPhi(x)\;+\;\psi(y)\; $，其中 $ \Phi(x) $ 是 $ \varphi(x) $ 的一个原函数， $ \psi(y) $ 是关于 y 的一元函数。由 $ z(x,0)=x $ 可得， $ \Phi(x)+\psi(0)=x $。由 $ z(0,y)=2y $ 可得， $ y+\Phi(0)+\psi(y)=2y $，即 $ \Phi(0)+\psi(y)=y $。在（2）式中令 y = 0 可得， $ \Phi(0)+\psi(0)=0 $。(1) 式减去 (3) 式可得 $ \Phi(x) - \Phi(0) = x $，即 $ \Phi(x) = \Phi(0) + x $。于是， $ \Phi(x)+\psi(y)=\Phi(0)+x+\psi(y)\xlongequal{(2) 式 }x+y $。因此， $ z(x,y)=ye^{x}+xy^{2}+x+y $。
sourceText: 900 第四章数二 B 类 22

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ f(x,y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且满足 $ \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(x,y)\right]}{\partial x\partial y}=1, f(0,y)=\sin y, f(x,0)=\sin x $，则 $ f\left(\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{\pi}{2}\right)= $ ___.
explanationMarkdown: 由 $ \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(x,y)\right]}{\partial x\partial y}=1 $得 $ \frac{\partial\left[f(x,y)\right]}{\partial y}=x+C_{1}(y) $，所以 $ f(x,y)=xy+\int C_{1}(y)\mathrm{d}y+C_{2}(x)=xy+C_{3}(y)+C_{2}(x) $。由 $ f(0,y)=\sin y,f(x,0)=\sin x $ 得 $ C_{2}(x)=\sin x-C_{3}(0),C_{3}(y)=\sin y-C_{2}(0) $，又 $ f(0,0)=0 $ ，所以 $ f(x,y)=xy+\sin x+\sin y $。因此 $ f\left(\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{\pi}{2}\right)=\frac{\pi^{2}}{4}+2. $

contentMarkdown: 设 $ f(x,y) $ 可微，满足 $ f^{\prime}_{x}(x,y)=-f(x,y) $， $ f^{\prime}_{y}(x,y)=\mathrm{e}^{-x}\cos y $，且 $ f(0,0)=0 $，求 $ \int f(x,x)dx $。
explanationMarkdown: 由 $ f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y)=-f(x,y) $，得 $ \frac{f_{x}(x,y)}{f(x,y)}=-1 $，从而 $ \ln|f(x,y)|=-x+\ln|C(y)| $，故 $ f(x,y)=C(y)\mathrm{e}^{-x} $。由 $ f'_y(x,y)=\mathrm{e}^{-x}\cos y $，得 $ C'(y)=\cos y $，从而 $ C(y)=\sin y+C $，故 $ f(x,y)=\mathrm{e}^{-x}(\sin y+C) $。由 $ f(0,0)=0 $，得 $ C=0 $，从而 $ f(x,y)=\mathrm{e}^{-x}\sin y $，故 $ \int f(x,x)\mathrm{d}x=\int\mathrm{e}^{-x}\sin x\mathrm{d}x=-\frac{1}{2}\mathrm{e}^{-x}(\sin x+\cos x)+C $。

contentMarkdown: 设 $ f(x,y) $ 可微，满足 $ f^{\prime}_{x}(x,y)=f(x,y) $， $ \lim_{n\to\infty}\left[\frac{f\left(0,y+\frac{1}{n}\right)}{f(0,y)}\right]^n=\mathrm{e}^{\cot y} $，且 $ f\left(0,\frac{\pi}{2}\right)=1 $，求 $ f(x,y) $。
explanationMarkdown: 令 $g(y)=f(0,y)$。题设中的商有定义，且极限为正数。取对数并令 $h=1/n$，有$$\begin{aligned}\ln\left\{\lim_{n\to\infty}\left[\frac{g(y+1/n)}{g(y)}\right]^n\right\}&=\lim_{h\to0^+}\frac{\ln|g(y+h)|-\ln|g(y)|}{h}\\&=\frac{g'(y)}{g(y)}\end{aligned}$$由题设，该式等于 $\cot y$，故$$\frac{g'(y)}{g(y)}=\cot y$$在包含 $\pi/2$ 的区间上积分，得 $g(y)=C\sin y$。由 $g(\pi/2)=f(0,\pi/2)=1$，可得 $C=1$，所以$$f(0,y)=g(y)=\sin y$$另一方面，$f_x(x,y)=f(x,y)$。把 $y$ 视为参数，解关于 $x$ 的微分方程，得$$f(x,y)=C(y)e^x$$代入 $f(0,y)=\sin y$，得到 $C(y)=\sin y$。因此$$f(x,y)=e^x\sin y$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ f(x,y) $ 为定义在全平面上的正值可微函数，满足 $ f(0,0)=1,\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}=\frac{1}{e^{y}+e^{-y}} $。若对任意 x，都有 $ \lim_{t\to0}\left[\frac{f(x+t,0)}{f(x,0)}\right]^{\frac{1}{t}}=\mathrm{e}^{\frac{x-1}{x^{2}-2x+4}} $，求 $ f(x,y) $。
explanationMarkdown: 将所给极限进行变形： $ \lim_{t\to0}\left[\frac{f(x+t,0)}{f(x,0)}\right]^{\frac{1}{t}}=\mathrm{e}^{\lim\limits_{t\to0}\frac{\ln f(x+t,0)-\ln f(x,0)}{t}} $。记 $ g(x)=f(x,0) $，则由导数定义可得 $ \lim_{t\to0}\frac{\ln f(x+t,0)-\ln f(x,0)}{t}=\left[\ln g(x)\right]^{\prime}=\frac{g^{\prime}(x)}{g(x)} $。由此可得 $ e^{\frac{g^{\prime}(x)}{g(x)}}=e^{\frac{x-1}{x^{2}-2x+4}} $。于是， $ \frac{g^{\prime}(x)}{g(x)}=\frac{x-1}{x^{2}-2x+4} $。分离变量可得， $ \frac{\mathrm{d}\left[g(x)\right]}{g(x)}=\frac{(x-1)\mathrm{d}x}{x^{2}-2x+4}=\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{\mathrm{d}(x^{2}-2x+4)}{x^{2}-2x+4} $。两端积分可得 $ \ln[g(x)] = \frac{1}{2}\ln(x^{2} - 2x + 4) + C_{0} $，等价于 $ g(x) = C_{1}\sqrt{x^{2} - 2x + 4} $，其中 $ C_{1} $ 为待定常数。将 $ f(0,0)=g(0)=1 $ 代入 $ g(x)=C_{1}\sqrt{x^{2}-2x+4} $ 可得 $ C_{1}=\frac{1}{2} $。因此， $ f(x,0)=\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{x^{2}-2x+4} $。另一方面，由 $ \frac{\partial f}{\partial y}=\frac{1}{\mathrm{e}^{y}+\mathrm{e}^{-y}} $ 可得， $ f(x,y)=\int\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{e}^{y}+\mathrm{e}^{-y}}=\int\frac{\mathrm{e}^{y}\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{e}^{2y}+1}=\int\frac{\mathrm{d}(\mathrm{e}^{y})}{(\mathrm{e}^{y})^{2}+1}=\arctan\mathrm{e}^{y}+\varphi(x) $。令 $ y = 0 $，可得 $ f(x,0) = \frac{\pi}{4} + \varphi(x) = \frac{1}{2} \sqrt{x^{2} - 2x + 4} $。于是， $ \varphi(x) = \frac{1}{2} \sqrt{x^{2} - 2x + 4} - \frac{\pi}{4} $。因此， $ f(x,y)=\arctan\mathrm{e}^{y}+\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{x^{2}-2x+4}-\frac{\pi}{4} $。
sourceText: 900 第四章数二 C 类 2

contentMarkdown: 设 $ f(x,y) $ 可微，满足 $ \frac{f_{y}^{\prime}(0,y)}{f(0,y)}=\cot y,f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y)=-f(x,y) $，且 $ f\left(0,\frac{\pi}{2}\right)=1 $，求 $ f(x,y) $。
explanationMarkdown: 由 $ \frac{f_{y}^{\prime}(0,y)}{f(0,y)}=\cot y $，得 $ \ln|f(0,y)|=\ln|\sin y|+\ln|C| $，故 $ f(0,y)=C\sin y $。由 $ f\left(0,\frac{\pi}{2}\right)=1 $，得 $ C=1 $，故 $ f(0,y)=\sin y $。由 $ f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y)=-f(x,y) $，得 $ \frac{f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y)}{f(x,y)}=-1 $，从而 $ \ln|f(x,y)|=-x+\ln|C(y)| $，故 $ f(x,y)=C(y)\mathrm{e}^{-x} $。由 $ f(0,y)=\sin y $，得 $ C(y)=\sin y $，故 $ f(x,y)=\mathrm{e}^{-x}\sin y $。

contentMarkdown: 已知可微函数 $ f(u,v) $ 满足 $ \frac{\partial f(u,v)}{\partial u} + \frac{\partial f(u,v)}{\partial v} = (u+v)e^{v} $，且 $ f(0,v) = (v-2)e^{v} $。则 $ f(x,x+y) = $ ___。
explanationMarkdown: 令 $ g(x,y) = f(x, x+y) $，则 $ \frac{\partial g}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial f}{\partial u} + \frac{\partial f}{\partial v} = (u+v)e^{v} $，其中 $ u = x, v = x+y $，代入得 $ \frac{\partial g}{\partial x} = (x + (x+y))e^{x+y} = (2x+y)e^{x+y} $。于是 $ g(x,y) = \int (2x+y)e^{x+y} dx = \int (2x+y) d e^{x+y} = (2x+y)e^{x+y} - 2\int e^{x+y} dx = (2x+y-2)e^{x+y} + C(y) $。由 $ g(0,y) = f(0,y) = (y-2)e^{y} $，代入得 $ (y-2)e^{y} + C(y) = (y-2)e^{y} $，故 $ C(y) = 0 $。因此 $ f(x,x+y) = g(x,y) = (2x+y-2)e^{x+y} $。

contentMarkdown: 设 $ z=\frac{u}{y}+e^{-ux}+f(u) $， $ u(x,y) $ 满足 $ xe^{-ux}-f'(u)=\frac{1}{y} $，其中 $ u(x,y) $ 和 $ f(u) $ 均可微，且 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $，求 $ u(x,y) $.
explanationMarkdown:
由 $ z = \frac{u}{y} + e^{-ux} + f(u) $，得
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}&=\frac{1}{y}\bullet\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-\mathrm{e}^{-u x}\Big(u+x\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\Big)+f^{\prime}(u)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\\&=-u\mathrm{e}^{-u x}+\left[\frac{1}{y}-x\mathrm{e}^{-u x}+f^{\prime}(u)\right]\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\\&=-u\mathrm{e}^{-u x},\end{aligned} 
$$
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}&=-\frac{u}{y^{2}}+\frac{1}{y}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}-\mathrm{e}^{-u x}x\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+f^{\prime}(u)\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\\&=-\frac{u}{y^{2}}+\left[\frac{1}{y}-x\mathrm{e}^{-u x}+f^{\prime}(u)\right]\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\\&=-\frac{u}{y^{2}}.\end{aligned} 
$$
由 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $，即 $ u\mathrm{e}^{-ux}=\frac{u}{y^{2}} $，解得 $ u(x,y)=\frac{\ln y^{2}}{x} $.

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ \ln z + e^{z-1} = xy $ 确定，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(2, \frac{1}{2})} = $ ___
explanationMarkdown:
（法一）对已知方程两端关于 $x$ 求导，可得 $ \frac{1}{z}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+e^{z-1}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=y $。将 $ x = 2, y = \frac{1}{2} $ 代入已知方程可得， $ \ln z + e^{z-1} = 1 $，解得 $z = 1$。将 $ x = 2, y = \frac{1}{2}, z = 1 $ 代入上式可得， $ 2\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(2,\frac{1}{2})} = \frac{1}{2} $，即 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(2,\frac{1}{2})} = \frac{1}{4} $。
（法二）记 $ F(x,y,z) = \ln z + e^{z-1} - xy $，则 $ F_{x}^{\prime}(x,y,z) = -y $， $ F_{z}^{\prime}(x,y,z) = \frac{1}{z} + e^{z-1} $。将 $ x = 2, y = \frac{1}{2} $ 代入已知方程可得 $z=1$。根据隐函数存在定理， $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(2,\frac{1}{2})}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}\left(2,\frac{1}{2},1\right)}{F_{z}^{\prime}\left(2,\frac{1}{2},1\right)}=-\frac{-\frac{1}{2}}{2}=\frac{1}{4} $。

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ (x + 1)z + y \ln z - \arctan(2xy) = 1 $ 确定，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,2)} = $ ___
explanationMarkdown:
将 $x=0, y=2$ 代入原方程得 $ z + 2 \ln z = 1 $，解得 $z = 1$。
方法一：对原方程两边关于 $x$ 求偏导，得 $ z + (x + 1)\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \cdot \frac{1}{z} \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - \frac{2y}{1 + 4x^2y^2} = 0 $。代入 $x=0, y=2, z=1$，得 $ 1 + \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + 2\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - 4 = 0 $，解得 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,2)} = 1 $。
方法二：记 $ F(x,y,z)=(x+1)z+y\ln z-\arctan(2xy)-1 $，则 $ F_{x}^{\prime}=z-\frac{2y}{1+4x^{2}y^{2}} $， $ F_{z}^{\prime}=x+1+\frac{y}{z} $。代入 $x=0, y=2, z=1$，得 $ F_{x}^{\prime}=1-4=-3 $， $ F_{z}^{\prime}=0+1+2=3 $。根据公式 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,2)}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}}{F_{z}^{\prime}}=-\frac{-3}{3}=1 $。

contentMarkdown:
设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由 $ z + \ln z - \int_{y}^{x} e^{-t^{2}} \, dt = 0 $ 确定，则 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = $

A. $ \frac{z}{z+1}\left(e^{-x^{2}}-e^{-y^{2}}\right) $
B. $ \frac{z}{z+1}\left(e^{-x^{2}}+e^{-y^{2}}\right) $
C. $ -\frac{z}{z+1}\left(e^{-x^{2}}-e^{-y^{2}}\right) $
D. $ -\frac{z}{z+1}\left(e^{-x^{2}}+e^{-y^{2}}\right) $
explanationMarkdown:
### 解析

**正确答案：A**

**方法一：利用隐函数求导公式**

设 $F(x, y, z) = z + \ln z - \int_{y}^{x} e^{-t^2} \mathrm{d}t$。

分别对 $x, y, z$ 求偏导数：

$$
F_x = -\frac{\partial}{\partial x} \int_{y}^{x} e^{-t^2} \mathrm{d}t = -e^{-x^2}
$$

$$
F_y = -\frac{\partial}{\partial y} \int_{y}^{x} e^{-t^2} \mathrm{d}t = -\left(-e^{-y^2}\right) = e^{-y^2}
$$

$$
F_z = 1 + \frac{1}{z} = \frac{z+1}{z}
$$

根据隐函数求导公式 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = -\frac{F_x}{F_z}$ 和 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -\frac{F_y}{F_z}$，可得：

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = -\frac{-e^{-x^2}}{\frac{z+1}{z}} = \frac{z}{z+1}e^{-x^2}
$$

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -\frac{e^{-y^2}}{\frac{z+1}{z}} = -\frac{z}{z+1}e^{-y^2}
$$

将两式相加：

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{z}{z+1}e^{-x^2} - \frac{z}{z+1}e^{-y^2} = \frac{z}{z+1}\left(e^{-x^2} - e^{-y^2}\right)
$$

**方法二：两边直接对 $x$ 和 $y$ 求偏导**

方程两边同时对 $x$ 求偏导（将 $y$ 视为常数，$z$ 视为 $x$ 的函数）：

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac{1}{z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - e^{-x^2} = 0
$$

提取公因式 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}$：

$$
\left(1 + \frac{1}{z}\right)\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = e^{-x^2} \implies \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{z}{z+1}e^{-x^2}
$$

同理，方程两边同时对 $y$ 求偏导（将 $x$ 视为常数，$z$ 视为 $y$ 的函数）：

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} + \frac{1}{z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} - \left(-e^{-y^2}\right) = 0
$$

提取公因式 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}$：

$$
\left(1 + \frac{1}{z}\right)\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -e^{-y^2} \implies \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -\frac{z}{z+1}e^{-y^2}
$$

两式相加即可得到最终结果：

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{z}{z+1}\left(e^{-x^2} - e^{-y^2}\right)
$$

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} = y \cos x + 2x $ 确定，则 $ \left. \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \right|_{(0,1)} = $ ___.
explanationMarkdown:
解法 1：对已知方程两端关于 $ x $ 求偏导数，可得 
$$
 \frac{1}{z+1}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\mathrm{e}^{z}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-y\sin x+2. 
$$
 将 $ x = 0, y = 1 $ 代入已知方程可得 $ \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} = 1 $。令 $ f(z) = \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} - 1 $，则 $ f'(z) = \frac{1}{z + 1} + e^{z} $。当 $ z > -1 $ 时， $ f'(z) > 0 $， $ f(z) $ 单调增加。观察可得 $ f(0) = 0 $，结合 $ f(z) $ 的单调性可知 $ z = 0 $ 为 $ f(z) $ 的唯一零点，即 $ z = 0 $ 为方程 $ \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} = 1 $ 的唯一实根。将 $ x = 0, y = 1, z = 0 $ 代入上式可得 $ 2\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,1)} = 2 $，即 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,1)} = 1 $。
解法 2：记 $ F(x, y, z) = \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} - y \cos x - 2x $，则 
$$
 F_{x}^{\prime}(x,y,z)=y\sin x-2,\quad F_{z}^{\prime}(x,y,z)=\frac{1}{z+1}+e^{z}. 
$$
 将 $ x = 0, y = 1 $ 代入已知方程可得 $ \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} = 1 $。同解法 1 得 $ z = 0 $。根据隐函数存在定理， 
$$
 \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,1)}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}(0,1,0)}{F_{z}^{\prime}(0,1,0)}=-\frac{-2}{2}=1. 
$$

设隐函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ y + z = x f(y^{2} - z^{2}) $ 确定，$ f $ 可微，则 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + z \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $ 等于

explanationMarkdown:
令 $ F(x,y,z)=y+z-xf(y^{2}-z^{2}) $，于是 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}}{F_{z}^{\prime}}=-\frac{-f}{1+2xzf^{\prime}}=\frac{f}{1+2xzf^{\prime}}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{F_{y}^{\prime}}{F_{z}^{\prime}}=-\frac{1-2xyf^{\prime}}{1+2xzf^{\prime}}, 
$$
 所以 $ x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+z\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{xf-z+2xyzf^{\prime}}{1+2xzf^{\prime}}=\frac{xf-xf+y+2xyzf^{\prime}}{1+2xzf^{\prime}}=y $。故应选(C)。

contentMarkdown: 设 $ f(x) $ 为连续函数，且 $ x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2} = \int_{x}^{y} f(x + y - t) \, dt $ 确定二元函数 $ z = z(x, y) $，则 $ z\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right) = $ ___.
explanationMarkdown: 令 $ x+y-t=u $，则 $ \int_{x}^{y}f(x+y-t)dt=-\int_{y}^{x}f(u)du $。记 $ F(x,y,z)=x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}+\int_{y}^{x}f(u)du $。由隐函数求导法则， $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{2x+f(x)}{2z} $， $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{2y-f(y)}{2z} $。因此，原式 $ = z \left( -\frac{2x+f(x)}{2z} - \frac{2y-f(y)}{2z} \right) = -x - y - \frac{1}{2} [f(x) - f(y)] $。

explanationMarkdown:
将 $ x=0, y=2 $ 代入 $ (x+1)z+2y\ln z-\arctan(xy)=1 $，有 $ z+4\ln z=1 $。因为 $ z + 4 \ln z $ 是 $ (0, +\infty) $ 上的增函数，且当 $ z = 1 $ 时， $ z + 4 \ln z = 1 $，从而解得 $ z = 1 $。在 $ (x+1)z+2y\ln z-\arctan(xy)=1 $ 两端对 $ x $ 求偏导，有 
$$
 z+(x+1)\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+2y\cdot\frac{1}{z}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}-\frac{1}{1+(xy)^{2}}\cdot y=0, 
$$
 将 $ x=0, y=2, z=1 $ 代入上式，解得 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,2)}=\frac{1}{5} $。

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ f(x,y,z)=\mathrm{e}^{z}yz^{2} $，若 $ z=z(x,y) $ 是由方程 $ x+y+z+xyz=0 $ 所确定的隐函数，记 $ g(x,y)=f(x,y,z(x,y)) $，则 $ g'_y(0,1)= $ ___.
explanationMarkdown:
解法 1：将 $ x = 0, y = 1 $ 代入 $ x + y + z + xyz = 0 $ 可得 $ z(0,1) + 1 = 0 $，即 $ z(0,1) = -1 $。根据链式法则， $ g_{y}^{\prime}(x,y)=\frac{\partial f(x,y,z(x,y))}{\partial y}=\mathrm{e}^{z}y z^{2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}+\mathrm{e}^{z}z^{2}+2\mathrm{e}^{z}y z\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\mathrm{e}^{z}y z(z+2)\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}+\mathrm{e}^{z}z^{2} $。对方程 $ x + y + z + xyz = 0 $ 两端关于 $ y $ 求偏导数，可得 $ 1 + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} + xz + xy \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = 0 $，解得 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -\frac{1 + xz}{1 + xy} $。代入上式可得 $ g_{y}^{\prime}(x,y)=-\mathrm{e}^{z}y z(z+2)\frac{1+x z}{1+x y}+\mathrm{e}^{z}z^{2} $。因此， $ g_{y}^{\prime}(0,1)=\mathrm{e}^{-1}+\mathrm{e}^{-1}=\frac{2}{\mathrm{e}} $。
解法 2：利用偏导数的定义。在方程 $ x + y + z + xyz = 0 $ 中代入 $ x = 0 $，可得 $ z(0, y) = -y $。 
$$
 \begin{aligned}g_{y}^{\prime}(0,1)&=\lim_{y\to1}\frac{f(0,y,z(0,y))-f(0,1,-1)}{y-1}=\lim_{y\to1}\frac{y^{3}\mathrm{e}^{-y}-\mathrm{e}^{-1}}{y-1}\\&\xlongequal{ 洛必达 }\lim_{y\to1}(3y^{2}\mathrm{e}^{-y}-y^{3}\mathrm{e}^{-y})=\frac{2}{\mathrm{e}}.\end{aligned} 
$$

A. 只能确定一个具有连续偏导数的隐函数 $ z = z(x, y) $.

explanationMarkdown:
设
$$
F(x,y,z)=xy-z\ln y+\mathrm{e}^{xz}-1.
$$
有 $F(0,1,1)=0$，且
$$
F_{x}^{\prime}=y+z\mathrm{e}^{xz},\quad F_{y}^{\prime}=x-\frac{z}{y},\quad F_{z}^{\prime}=-\ln y+x\mathrm{e}^{xz}.
$$
代入 $(0,1,1)$ 得
$$
F_{x}^{\prime}(0,1,1)=2,\quad F_{y}^{\prime}(0,1,1)=-1,\quad F_{z}^{\prime}(0,1,1)=0.
$$
根据隐函数存在定理，可在该点邻域内确定 $x=x(y,z)$ 与 $y=y(x,z)$，但不能由该定理确定 $z=z(x,y)$。因此选 D。

explanationMarkdown: 由 $ z = f(u) $ 可知 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = f'(u)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}, \quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = f'(u)\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} $。对方程 $ u = \varphi(u) + \int_{y}^{x} p(t) dt $ 两边分别对 $ x $ 和 $ y $ 求偏导，得 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \varphi'(u)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + p(x) $， $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = \varphi'(u)\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} - p(y) $。整理得 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{p(x)}{1 - \varphi'(u)} $， $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = -\frac{p(y)}{1 - \varphi'(u)} $。代入 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} $ 和 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $ 的表达式，得 $ p(y) \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + p(x) \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = p(y) f'(u) \cdot \frac{p(x)}{1 - \varphi'(u)} + p(x) f'(u) \cdot \left( -\frac{p(y)}{1 - \varphi'(u)} \right) = 0 $。

contentMarkdown: 设 $ z = z(x, y) $ 是由方程 $ F\left(\frac{1}{x} - \frac{1}{y} - \frac{1}{z}\right) = \frac{1}{z} $ 确定的隐函数，其中 $ F $ 可微，求 $ x^{2} \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y^{2} \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $。
explanationMarkdown: 方法一：方程 $ F\left(\frac{1}{x}-\frac{1}{y}-\frac{1}{z}\right)=\frac{1}{z} $，两边分别对 $ x,y $ 求导，得 $ \begin{cases}F^{\prime}\bullet\left(-\frac{1}{x^{2}}+\frac{1}{z^{2}}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)=-\frac{1}{z^{2}}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x},\\F^{\prime}\bullet\left(\frac{1}{y^{2}}+\frac{1}{z^{2}}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)=-\frac{1}{z^{2}}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y},\end{cases} $。解得 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{z^{2}F^{\prime}}{(F^{\prime}+1)x^{2}},\quad\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{z^{2}F^{\prime}}{(F^{\prime}+1)y^{2}} $，故 $ x^{2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y^{2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=0 $。方法二：用公式求。令 $ G=F\left(\frac{1}{x}-\frac{1}{y}-\frac{1}{z}\right)-\frac{1}{z} $，则 $ G_{x}^{\prime}=F^{\prime}\bullet\left(-\frac{1}{x^{2}}\right),\quad G_{y}^{\prime}=F^{\prime}\bullet\frac{1}{y^{2}},\quad G_{z}^{\prime}=F^{\prime}\bullet\frac{1}{z^{2}}+\frac{1}{z^{2}} $，故 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{G_{x}^{\prime}}{G_{z}^{\prime}}=\frac{z^{2}F^{\prime}}{x^{2}(F^{\prime}+1)},\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{G_{y}^{\prime}}{G_{z}^{\prime}}=-\frac{z^{2}F^{\prime}}{y^{2}(F^{\prime}+1)} $，从而 $ x^{2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y^{2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=0 $。

contentMarkdown: 设 $y=g(x,z)$，$z=z(x,y)$ 是由方程 $f(x-z,xy)=0$ 确定的函数，求 $\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}$。
explanationMarkdown:
由 $y=g(x,z)$ 且 $z=z(x,y)$，对 $x$ 求全导数，得
$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=g_1'+g_2'\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right).
$$
再由
$$
f(x-z,xy)=0
$$
分别对 $x,y$ 求偏导，得
$$
f_1'\left(1-\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)+yf_2'=0,
$$
以及
$$
-f_1'\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}+xf_2'=0.
$$
所以
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=1+\frac{yf_2'}{f_1'},\;\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{xf_2'}{f_1'}.
$$
代回并整理，得
$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{f_1'g_1'+g_2'(f_1'+yf_2')}{f_1'-xf_2'g_2'}.
$$

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ F\left(x + \frac{z}{y}, y + \frac{z}{x}\right) = 0 $ 确定，且 $ F(u, v) $ 具有连续偏导数，求 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $.
explanationMarkdown: 将方程 $ F\left(x+\frac{z}{y},y+\frac{z}{x}\right)=0 $ 两边对 $ x $ 求导得 $ F_{1}^{\prime}\bullet\Big(1+\frac{1}{y}\bullet\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\Big)+F_{2}^{\prime}\bullet\Big(-\frac{z}{x^{2}}+\frac{1}{x}\bullet\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\Big)=0 $，则 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{y(zF_{2}^{\prime}-x^{2}F_{1}^{\prime})}{x(xF_{1}^{\prime}+yF_{2}^{\prime})} $。将方程 $ F\left(x+\frac{z}{y},y+\frac{z}{x}\right)=0 $ 两边对 $ y $ 求导得 $ F_{1}^{\prime}\bullet\left(-\frac{z}{y^{2}}+\frac{1}{y}\bullet\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)+F_{2}^{\prime}\bullet\left(1+\frac{1}{x}\bullet\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)=0 $，则 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{x\left(zF_{1}^{\prime}-y^{2}F_{2}^{\prime}\right)}{y\left(xF_{1}^{\prime}+yF_{2}^{\prime}\right)} $。所以 $ x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{z(xF_{1}^{\prime}+yF_{2}^{\prime})-(xF_{1}^{\prime}+yF_{2}^{\prime})xy}{xF_{1}^{\prime}+yF_{2}^{\prime}}=z-xy $。

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ F(u,v) $ 可微，且 $ F\left(x+\frac{z}{y},y+\frac{z}{x}\right)=0 $ 确定隐函数 $ z = z(x,y) $，则 $ z - x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = $ ___.
explanationMarkdown:
这是一个经典的多元复合函数隐函数求导问题。解决这类问题的关键是引入中间变量，并熟练、准确地运用**多元链式法则**。

我们可以通过设出中间变量，分别求出偏导数 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}$ 和 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $，最后代入目标式子进行化简。

### 解题步骤

**第一步：设定中间变量及记号**
令 $ u = x + \frac{z}{y} $， $ v = y + \frac{z}{x} $。
此时原方程化为 $ F(u, v) = 0 $。
记 $F$ 对第一个变量 $u$ 的偏导数为 $ F_1 $，对第二个变量 $v$ 的偏导数为 $ F_2 $。

**第二步：求 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} $**
对方程 $F\left(x+\frac{z}{y}, y+\frac{z}{x}\right)=0$ 两边同时对 $x$ 求偏导（把 $y$ 视为常数），根据链式法则有：
$$
F_1 \cdot \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + F_2 \cdot \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} = 0
$$

分别计算 $u$ 和 $v$ 对 $x$ 的偏导数（注意 $z$ 是 $x,y$ 的函数）：
* $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = 1 + \frac{1}{y}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}$
* $\frac{\partial v}{\partial x} = \frac{x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - z}{x^2} = \frac{1}{x}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - \frac{z}{x^2}$

将其代入上式：
$$
F_1 \left(1 + \frac{1}{y}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right) + F_2 \left(\frac{1}{x}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - \frac{z}{x^2}\right) = 0
$$

将含有 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}$ 的项移到一边，整理可得：
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \left( \frac{F_1}{y} + \frac{F_2}{x} \right) = \frac{z F_2}{x^2} - F_1
$$
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \left( \frac{x F_1 + y F_2}{xy} \right) = \frac{z F_2 - x^2 F_1}{x^2}
$$
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{y(z F_2 - x^2 F_1)}{x(x F_1 + y F_2)}
$$

**第三步：求 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $**
同理，对方程两边同时对 $y$ 求偏导（把 $x$ 视为常数）：
$$
F_1 \cdot \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} + F_2 \cdot \frac{\partial v}{\partial y} = 0
$$

分别计算偏导：
* $\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = \frac{y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} - z}{y^2} = \frac{1}{y}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} - \frac{z}{y^2}$
* $\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} = 1 + \frac{1}{x}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}$

代入后得到：
$$
F_1 \left(\frac{1}{y}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} - \frac{z}{y^2}\right) + F_2 \left(1 + \frac{1}{x}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right) = 0
$$

整理求解 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $：
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} \left( \frac{F_1}{y} + \frac{F_2}{x} \right) = \frac{z F_1}{y^2} - F_2
$$
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} \left( \frac{x F_1 + y F_2}{xy} \right) = \frac{z F_1 - y^2 F_2}{y^2}
$$
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{x(z F_1 - y^2 F_2)}{y(x F_1 + y F_2)}
$$

**第四步：代入目标表达式化简**
我们需要计算 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $：
* $x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{y(z F_2 - x^2 F_1)}{x F_1 + y F_2} = \frac{yz F_2 - x^2 y F_1}{x F_1 + y F_2}$
* $y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{x(z F_1 - y^2 F_2)}{x F_1 + y F_2} = \frac{xz F_1 - xy^2 F_2}{x F_1 + y F_2}$

将这两部分相加：
$$
x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{-x^2 y F_1 + yz F_2 + xz F_1 - xy^2 F_2}{x F_1 + y F_2}
$$

对分子按照 $F_1$ 和 $F_2$ 提取公因式：
* $F_1$ 的系数：$ xz - x^2 y = x(z - xy) $
* $F_2$ 的系数：$ yz - xy^2 = y(z - xy) $

因此分子可以化简为：
$$
(xz - x^2 y)F_1 + (yz - xy^2)F_2 = (z - xy)(x F_1 + y F_2)
$$

代回原式：
$$
x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{(z - xy)(x F_1 + y F_2)}{x F_1 + y F_2} = z - xy
$$

最后，计算题目所求的完整表达式：
$$
z - x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = z - (z - xy) = xy
$$

---

**最终答案：** $ xy $

explanationMarkdown:
由隐函数存在定理可得 
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\cdot\frac{\partial x}{\partial y}\cdot\frac{\partial y}{\partial z}=\left(-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}}{F_{z}^{\prime}}\right)\cdot\left(-\frac{F_{y}^{\prime}}{F_{x}^{\prime}}\right)\cdot\left(-\frac{F_{z}^{\prime}}{F_{y}^{\prime}}\right)=-1.
$$
 于是，选项 C 不正确，选项 D 正确。取 $F(x,y,z)=2x+y-z$ , 则 $\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}=2,\frac{\partial F}{\partial y}=1,\frac{\partial F}{\partial z}=-1$ . 选项 A 不正确. 由隐函数存在定理， $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}}{F_{z}^{\prime}}=2,\frac{\partial x}{\partial y}=-\frac{F_{y}^{\prime}}{F_{x}^{\prime}}=-\frac{1}{2},\frac{\partial y}{\partial z}=-\frac{F_{z}^{\prime}}{F_{y}^{\prime}}=1.$ 选项 B 不正确. 综上所述，应选 D.

contentMarkdown: 设 $z = z(x, y)$ 是由方程 $x^{2} + y^{2} - z = \varphi(x + y + z)$ 所确定的函数，其中 $\varphi$ 具有 2 阶导数且 $\varphi' \neq -1$ 时. （1）求 $\mathrm{d}z$；（2）记 $u(x,y)=\frac{1}{x-y}\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)$，求 $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$.
answerMarkdown: （1）$\displaystyle \mathrm{d}z=\frac{2x-\varphi^{\prime}}{1+\varphi^{\prime}}\mathrm{d}x+\frac{2y-\varphi^{\prime}}{1+\varphi^{\prime}}\mathrm{d}y$；（2）$\displaystyle \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=-\frac{2(1+2x)\varphi^{\prime\prime}}{(\varphi^{\prime}+1)^{3}}$，其中 $\varphi^{\prime},\varphi^{\prime\prime}$ 均在 $x+y+z$ 处取值。
explanationMarkdown:
(1) 对方程 $x^{2} + y^{2} - z = \varphi(x + y + z)$ 两边全微分： 
$$
\begin{aligned}\mathrm{d}\left(x^{2}\right)+\mathrm{d}\left(y^{2}\right)-\mathrm{d}z&=\mathrm{d}\varphi\left(x+y+z\right),\\ 2x\mathrm{d}x+2y\mathrm{d}y-\mathrm{d}z&=\varphi^{\prime}\left(x+y+z\right)\mathrm{d}\left(x+y+z\right)\\&=\varphi^{\prime}\left(x+y+z\right)\left(\mathrm{d}x+\mathrm{d}y+\mathrm{d}z\right)\\&=\varphi^{\prime}\mathrm{d}x+\varphi^{\prime}\mathrm{d}y+\varphi^{\prime}\mathrm{d}z.\end{aligned}
$$
 移项合并得 
$$
\left(\varphi^{\prime}+1\right)\mathrm{d}z=\left(-\varphi^{\prime}+2x\right)\mathrm{d}x+\left(-\varphi^{\prime}+2y\right)\mathrm{d}y.
$$
 由于 $\varphi' \neq -1$，有 
$$
\mathrm{d}z=\frac{(-\varphi'+2x)\mathrm{d}x+(-\varphi'+2y)\mathrm{d}y}{\varphi'+1}.
$$
 (2) 由 $\mathrm{d}z$ 表达式知 
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{-\varphi^{\prime}+2x}{\varphi^{\prime}+1},\quad\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{-\varphi^{\prime}+2y}{\varphi^{\prime}+1}.
$$
 代入 $u(x,y)$： 
$$
\begin{aligned}u(x,y)&=\frac{1}{x-y}\left(\frac{-\varphi^{\prime}+2x}{\varphi^{\prime}+1}-\frac{-\varphi^{\prime}+2y}{\varphi^{\prime}+1}\right)\\&=\frac{1}{x-y}\cdot\frac{-2y+2x}{\varphi^{\prime}+1}=\frac{2}{\varphi^{\prime}+1}.\end{aligned}
$$
 对 $u$ 求偏导 $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$，注意 $\varphi'$ 是 $x+y+z$ 的函数： 
$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}&=\frac{-2\left[\varphi^{\prime}\left(x+y+z\right)\right]_{x}^{\prime}}{\left(\varphi^{\prime}+1\right)^{2}}\\&=\frac{-2\left(1+\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)\varphi^{\prime\prime}}{\left(\varphi^{\prime}+1\right)^{2}}.\end{aligned}
$$
 代入 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{2x-\varphi'}{1+\varphi'}$： 
$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}&=-\frac{2\left(1+\frac{2x-\varphi'}{1+\varphi'}\right)\varphi^{\prime\prime}}{\left(\varphi^{\prime}+1\right)^{2}}\\&=-\frac{2\left(\frac{1+\varphi'+2x-\varphi'}{1+\varphi'}\right)\varphi^{\prime\prime}}{\left(\varphi^{\prime}+1\right)^{2}}\\&=-\frac{2(1+2x)\varphi^{\prime\prime}}{\left(\varphi^{\prime}+1\right)^{3}}.\end{aligned}
$$
 综上所述， $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=-\frac{2(1+2x)\varphi^{\prime\prime}}{(\varphi^{\prime}+1)^{3}}.$

解（Ⅰ）解法1 对方程 $ 2xy - z = \varphi(x + 2y + 3z) $ 两端分别关于 $x$, $y$ 求偏导数，得 $ 2y - \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \varphi'(x + 2y + 3z) \left(1 + 3\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right) $， $ 2x - \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \varphi'(x + 2y + 3z) \left(2 + 3\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right) $。由于 $ \varphi'(t) \neq -\frac{1}{3} $，故 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{2y - \varphi'(x + 2y + 3z)}{3\varphi'(x + 2y + 3z) + 1} $， $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{2x - 2\varphi'(x + 2y + 3z)}{3\varphi'(x + 2y + 3z) + 1} $。因此， $ \mathrm{d}z = \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \mathrm{d}x + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} \mathrm{d}y = \frac{2y - \varphi'(x + 2y + 3z)}{3\varphi'(x + 2y + 3z) + 1} \mathrm{d}x + \frac{2x - 2\varphi'(x + 2y + 3z)}{3\varphi'(x + 2y + 3z) + 1} \mathrm{d}y $。
解法 2 对方程 $ 2xy - z = \varphi(x + 2y + 3z) $ 两端微分，可得
$$
 2y\mathrm{d}x+2x\mathrm{d}y-\mathrm{d}z=\varphi^{\prime}\left(x+2y+3z\right)\mathrm{d}x+2\varphi^{\prime}\left(x+2y+3z\right)\mathrm{d}y+3\varphi^{\prime}\left(x+2y+3z\right)\mathrm{d}z. 
$$
 
由于 $\varphi^{\prime}(t)\neq-\frac{1}{3}$，故 $\mathrm{d}z=\frac{2y-\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)}{3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1}\mathrm{d}x+\frac{2x-2\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)}{3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1}\mathrm{d}y$。
(Ⅱ) 由第(Ⅰ)问中所求 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x},\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $的表达式可知，
$$
 u(x,y)=\frac{1}{x-2y}\cdot\frac{4y-2x}{3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1}=\frac{-2}{3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1}. 
$$
 
于是，
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}&=\frac{2\cdot\frac{\partial\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)\right]}{\partial x}}{\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1\right]^{2}}=\frac{6\varphi^{\prime \prime}(x+2y+3z)\cdot\left(1+3\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)}{\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1\right]^{2}}\\&=\frac{6(6y+1)\varphi^{\prime \prime}(x+2y+3z)}{\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1\right]^{3}}.\end{aligned} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}&=\frac{2\cdot\frac{\partial\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)\right]}{\partial y}}{\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1\right]^{2}}=\frac{6\varphi^{\prime \prime}(x+2y+3z)\cdot\left(2+3\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)}{\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1\right]^{2}}\\&=\frac{6(6x+2)\varphi^{\prime \prime}(x+2y+3z)}{\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1\right]^{3}}.\end{aligned} 
$$
 
因此， $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{6(6y-6x-1)\varphi''(x+2y+3z)}{\left[3\varphi'(x+2y+3z)+1\right]^3}. $

contentMarkdown: 已知 $ u + e^{u} = xy $，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y} $。
explanationMarkdown:
由 $u+e^u=xy$，两边分别对 $x,y$ 求偏导，得 
$$
u_x(1+e^u)=y,\qquad u_y(1+e^u)=x,
$$
 即 
$$
u_x=\frac{y}{1+e^u},\qquad u_y=\frac{x}{1+e^u}.
$$
 再对 $u_x=\dfrac{y}{1+e^u}$ 关于 $y$ 求导，得 
$$
u_{xy}=\frac{1}{1+e^u}-\frac{y e^u u_y}{(1+e^u)^2}=\frac{1}{1+e^u}-\frac{xy e^u}{(1+e^u)^3}.
$$
 由 $xy=u+e^u$，可化为 
$$
u_{xy}=\frac{(1+e^u)^2-(u+e^u)e^u}{(1+e^u)^3}=\frac{1+(2-u)e^u}{(1+e^u)^3}.
$$

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由 $ e^{z} + xz = 2x - y $ 确定，则 $ \left. \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}} \right|_{(1,1)} = $ ___。
explanationMarkdown: 将 $ x=1, y=1 $ 代入方程 $ e^{z} + xz = 2x - y $，得 $ e^{z}+z=1 \Rightarrow z=0 $。方程两边对 x 求偏导： $ e^{z}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+z+x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=2 \Rightarrow \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(1,1)}=1 $。再对 x 求偏导： $ e^{z}(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x})^{2}+e^{z}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+x\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}=0 \Rightarrow \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}\bigg|_{(1,1)}=-\frac{3}{2} $。

contentMarkdown: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ z + e^{x} - y \ln(1 + z^{2}) = 0 $ 确定，求 $ \left(\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}} + \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}\right)_{(0,0)} $。
explanationMarkdown: 将 $ x=0 $，$ y=0 $ 代入方程 $ z+e^{x}-y\ln(1+z^{2})=0 $，得 $ z(0,0)=-1 $。方程两边对 x 求偏导： $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\mathrm{e}^{x}=\frac{2yz}{1+z^{2}}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} $，因此 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,0)}=-1 $。方程两边对 y 求偏导： $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\ln(1+z^{2})+\frac{2yz}{1+z^{2}}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $，因此 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{(0,0)}=\ln2 $。对 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+e^{x}=\frac{2yz}{1+z^{2}}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} $ 两边继续对 x 求偏导： $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\mathrm{e}^{x}=\frac{2y z}{1+z^{2}}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{2y(1-z^{2})}{(1+z^{2})^{2}}\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)^{2} $，因此 $ \left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}\right|_{(0,0)}=-1 $。对 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\ln(1+z^{2})+\frac{2yz}{1+z^{2}}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $ 两边继续对 y 求偏导： $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=\frac{4z}{1+z^{2}}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}+\frac{2y\left(1-z^{2}\right)}{\left(1+z^{2}\right)^{2}}\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)^{2}+\frac{2yz}{1+z^{2}}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}} $，因此 $ \left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}\right|_{(0,0)}=-2\ln2 $。综上， $ \left(\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}\right)\bigg|_{(0,0)}=-1-2\ln2 $。

contentMarkdown: 设 $ z = z(x, y) $ 是由 $ z + e^{z} = xy $ 所确定的二元函数，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{z=0} = $ ___。
explanationMarkdown: 将 $ z + e^{z} = xy $ 写成 $ F(x, y, z) = xy - z - e^{z} = 0 $，按隐函数求导公式，有 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}(x,y,z)}{F_{z}^{\prime}(x,y,z)}=-\frac{y}{-1-\mathrm{e}^{z}}=\frac{y}{1+\mathrm{e}^{z}} $， $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{F_{y}^{\prime}(x,y,z)}{F_{z}^{\prime}(x,y,z)}=-\frac{x}{-1-\mathrm{e}^{z}}=\frac{x}{1+\mathrm{e}^{z}} $。故 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=\frac{\partial}{\partial y}\Big(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\Big)=\frac{\partial}{\partial y}\Big(\frac{y}{1+\mathrm{e}^{z}}\Big)=\frac{1+\mathrm{e}^{z}-y\mathrm{e}^{z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}}{(1+\mathrm{e}^{z})^{2}}=\frac{1}{1+\mathrm{e}^{z}}-\frac{xy\mathrm{e}^{z}}{(1+\mathrm{e}^{z})^{3}} $。以 $ z = 0 $ 代入 $ F(x, y, z) = 0 $ 中，得 $ xy = 1 $，从而得 $ \left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{z=0} = \frac{3}{8} $。

contentMarkdown: 已知函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ e^{z} + xz - y\ln x = 1 $ 所确定，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{(1,1)} = $_ .
explanationMarkdown:
将 $ x = 1, y = 1 $ 代入原方程得 $ e^{z} + z = 1 $. 令 $ g(z) = e^{z} + z - 1 $, 则 $ g'(z) = e^{z} + 1 > 0 $, $ g(z) $ 单调增加. 观察可得 $ g(0) = 0 $, 结合 $ g(z) $ 的单调性可知 $ z = 0 $ 为 $ g(z) $ 的唯一零点, 即 $ z(1,1) = 0 $. 对已知方程两端分别关于 $ x $ 和 $ y $ 求偏导得： 
$$
 \begin{aligned} e^{z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+z-\frac{y}{x}&=0,\\ e^{z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}+x\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}-\ln x&=0. \end{aligned} 
$$
 代入 $ x = 1, y = 1, z = 0 $ 得， 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+0-1=0,\quad\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}-0=0. 
$$
 解得 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(1,1)}=\frac{1}{2},\left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{(1,1)}=0. $ 继续对第一个偏导式两端关于 $ y $ 求偏导数可得， 
$$
 e^{z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+e^{z}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}+x\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}-\frac{1}{x}=0. 
$$
 代入 $ x = 1, y = 1, z = 0, \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(1,1)} = \frac{1}{2}, \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{(1,1)} = 0 $ 得, $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} - 1 = 0 $. 解得 $ \left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{(1,1)} = \frac{1}{2} $.
sourceText: 900 第四章数二 A 类 26

contentMarkdown: 设 $ z = z(x, y) $ 是由方程 $ 3x + xyz + z^{3} = 1 $ 所确定的函数，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}\right|_{x=0,y=0} = $ ______.
explanationMarkdown:
令 $ F(x,y,z)=3x+xyz+z^{3}-1 $，则 $ F_{x}^{\prime}=3+yz $， $ F_{z}^{\prime}=xy+3z^{2} $. 当 $ x=0 $，$ y=0 $ 时，由方程得 $ z=1 $，于是， 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}}{F_{z}^{\prime}}=-\frac{3+yz}{xy+3z^{2}},\quad.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}|_{\substack{x=0\\ y=0}}=-\frac{3+yz}{xy+3z^{2}}|_{\substack{x=0\\ y=0\\ z=1}}=-1, 
$$
 
$$
 \left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}\right|_{\substack{x=0\\ y=0}}=-\left.\frac{y\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}(x y+3z^{2})-(3+y z)\left(y+6z\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)}{(x y+3z^{2})^{2}}\right|_{\substack{x=0\\ y=0\\ z=1}}=-2. 
$$

contentMarkdown:
设 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2} - 2x - 4y - 2z = 0 $（$z \gt 0$）确定，则当 $ x = 2, y = 4 $ 时，下列选项正确的是？

A. $ z_{x}^{\prime}=1. $
B. $ z_{y}^{\prime}=2. $
C. $ z_{xx}^{\prime\prime}=-2. $
D. $ z_{yy}^{\prime\prime}=5. $
explanationMarkdown:
当 $ x = 2, y = 4 $ 时，原方程化为 $ z^{2} - 2z = 0 $. 由已知条件 $ z > 0 $，得 $ z = 2 $. 原方程两端分别关于 $ x $ 和 $ y $ 求偏导数得： 
$$
 2x+2z z_{x}^{\prime}-2-2z_{x}^{\prime}=0,\quad2y+2z z_{y}^{\prime}-4-2z_{y}^{\prime}=0. 
$$
 代入 $ x = 2, y = 4, z = 2 $ 可得 $ z_{x}^{\prime} = -1, z_{y}^{\prime} = -2 $. 对上述两式两端分别关于 $ x, y $ 求偏导数得： 
$$
 2+2(z_{x}^{\prime})^{2}+2zz_{xx}^{\prime\prime}-2z_{xx}^{\prime\prime}=0,\quad2+2(z_{y}^{\prime})^{2}+2zz_{yy}^{\prime\prime}-2z_{yy}^{\prime\prime}=0. 
$$
 代入 $ x = 2, y = 4, z = 2, z_{x}^{\prime} = -1, z_{y}^{\prime} = -2 $ 可得 $ z_{xx}^{\prime\prime} = -2, z_{yy}^{\prime\prime} = -5 $. 应选 C.
